headers.im: Suencuek he Greek ol lamtah “Genesis” a ti. He cabu dongah a soeprhaep kah a tongnah a thui. Lunglai a tongnah, hlanghing a tongnah, Israel pilnam a tongnah kawng te a thui.
headers.ip: Abraham neh Sarah te Kanaan la puen uh. Te khohmuen te ni Pathen loh a cadil taengah paek ham Pathen loh ol a khueh. A patong soi ah capa Isaak te a sak rhoi. Isaak loh Jakop neh Esau a cun. Cabu a bawtnah dongah Jakop neh a ca rhoek hlainit imkhui cako tah puen uh tih Egypt ah kho a sak uh. Amih boeinaphung khuiah Joseph tah Egypt ah boei la om uh. Pathen loh a pilnam ham a olkam a cak sak te Joseph loh a ming. Te dongah
headers.qt: “Kai ka duek cakhaw Pathen loh nangmih n'hip khaw n'hip vetih nangmih te tahae kah kho lamkah Abraham , Isaak neh Jakob ham a toemngam tangtae khohmuen la khuen bitni,” a ti nah.

headers.im: Sunglatnah he Greek lamah exodus a ti. A thui ngaihnah tah sal khui lamloh amah kho la a mael ke a thuingaihnah. He cabu dongah Boeipa loh a pilnam Israel ca rhoek Egypt lamloh a doek tih a mawt kawng te a thui.
headers.ip: A tloihsoi kah (Sng 19—40) he tah Sinai tlang kah aka thoeng te ni a thui. Te ah te Pathen loh Moses a voek. Te vaengah anih te Pathen loh bawknah, hmueihhlutnah, vuenhlaem khosaknah, khosoih hnicu, Dap hmuencim, hmueihtuk ham olkhueng a paek. Kai tah sal la na om nah Egypt kho lamloh aka coe puei YHWH Pathen ni a ti lalah mueirhol a saii uh tih kutsai pathen a bawk uh kawng khaw a tueng sak.

headers.ip: He cabu he Hebrew ol dongah tah, “Khosoek ah om vaengkah” tila a om dongah Matu ol lamtah
headers.tila: kong la om. Cabu a tong vaengah he Israel ca rhoek Sinai khosoek ah a rhaehnah kawng a thui. Pilnam kawng te Boeipa loh Moses taengah a thui. A longpueng li vaengkah ham neh bawknah vaengkah ham olrhi te a thui pah. Pilnam loh yincaehnah a tong vaengah Kannan khohmuen khaw, Kadesh khohmuen long a pah ham khaw, Kanaan te tuithim lamloh a muk ham khaw a thui pah. Tedae Edom khohmuen tah a kaep long a hil uh. Lampahnah dongah he pilnam loh boe a koek uh tih Pathen taengah a kohuetnah kawng khaw a thui. Moses a dueknah hnuk tah Pathen loh pilnam mawtkung la Joshua a coelh tih olkhueh ram te dangdoe lamloh a dan sak.

headers.a: ti he tah Yahovah-Shua tih Yahovah Tah khangkung Boeipa. Greek ol lamtah (Jesuh) la om.
headers.He: cabu he Moses a dueknah hnukah Israel ca rhoek mawt hamla a tuek Joshua ming la a khueh. Joshua mawtnah hmuiah Israel ca rhoek loh Kannan ram a lohnah, Israel koca hlainit hamla khohmuen a taelnah kawng a thui. Abraham taengah Pathen loh ol a khueh kawng he olpuei la a tueng sak. Te Boeipa kah kutdoe khohmuen te amih taengla a pha coeng. Israel ca rhoek loh Boeipa taengah huek boe a ngai uh vaengah Kannan khopuei rhoek te a loh uh thai. Jerekho bangla khopuei vongcak pataeng tim. Kannan te Israel kut hmuiah boeih om hlan dae Pathen loh Joshua taengah, “Jordan tuiva khotlak te koca hlainit ham tael pah laeh,”
headers.Cabu: he Joshua kah olrho phihnah ol neh bawt. Joshua loh pilnam te Pathen taengah uepom la om ham a uen. Olpuei la Shekhem kah a tingtun uh vaengah YHWH Pathen bueng te bawk ham neh, pathen tloe bawk pawt ham paipi a ok uh.

headers.400: tluk vaengah daek coini tila poeknah om.
headers.im: Laitloekkung rhoek neh Israel manghai rhoek a om tom vaengkah ni. Ruth kawng cil ol a toi ca bawt a daek. Bethlehem kah cako pakhat te khokha dongah khothoeng kah Moab ram la a poenngnah kawng a thui. Kho a sak li vaengah a ca rhoi loh Moab nu a yunah rhoi. Kum rha tluk a om vaengah a ca rhoi neh a va khaw duek tih Naomi te nuhmai la om. Te vaengah Bethlehem ah khobuh coeng tila a yaak dongah mael hamla cai. A langa rhoi loh a vai dae Moab ah khosa rhoi mai a ti nah. Te vaengah Orpah loh a ngai tih Ruth tah Judah ram la cet ham altha. Ruth he bahoeng khuel tih a hnukah tah Boaz loh a yunah. Ruth he Moab hoel la om dae Jew hlang a vanah rhang neh a casak lamloh manghai David he thoeng. Ruth dongah he yan Palestine ram kah lotawn cangah kawng khaw, manuca neh nuhmai cadah ham khokhan kawng khaw a thui.

headers.Israel: ca rhoek kah khokhuen neh cil te a tueng sak tih tonghma Samuel a cunnah lamloh manghai David a dueknah hill a daek. He cabu dongah Israel ram a moecuek vaengkah thinom Samuel, Saul neh David kawng om. Israel ca rhoek te amah koca rhoek kah mawtnah laitloek nah voevoeh hma tih manghai mawtnah ben la cet.
headers.ip: Lamhma cuek la Samuel kah a thangnah, Pathen loh a khue nah, tonghma neh camtloek boeilu la a omnah kawng a thui. Namtom bangla pilnam loh amih aka mawtkung ham manghai a hoe uh. Te vaengah Pathen loh Samuel la, “Benjamin koca lamkah,” a ti nah. Saul neh Pathen loh a ngaihaknah hmanah Boeipa ol te Saul loh ngai pawh. Te dongah Saul te manghai lamloh a paa sak tih David a tuek sak. Saul loh David te thunkha rhalcak bangla a khueh vaengah David he Samuel loh a bom. headers.im: Samuel cabu a pabae he khaw a pacuek kah ngencawn ni. David a manghai tue 1010 -970
headers.vaengkah: te a tael. David kah a boei a mang neh rhuepomnah khaw, a tlaknah khaw a tael dongah khokhuen cil aka tae boeih ham thaphohnah neh rhalrhingnah la om. Pathen kah a coelh vanbangla Israel manghai rhoek boeih lakah khaw David long caemtloek vaengah rhal a ta ngai. Aram kah khopuei la Jerusalem a saii, a im a sak, pipi thingkawng khaw te lamte a khuen. Pathen loh rhalmongnah a paek tih David kah cadil khui lamkah manghai la phat om saeh a ti. Te lalah khaw David loh hlang yuu a rhawt pah tih, amah tholh dah a ngaih uet ah uepom la aka om, ommongsitoe hlang te a ngawn. Te dongah David kah tholhnah loh
headers.ni: a veet coeng. Te dongah David imkhui te boekoeknah neh thekthek a phen pah. Cabu a bawtnah ah Pathen dongah pangtung atah thaomnah la coeng tih, altha atah puencaknah a om te a tueng sak.

headers.im: Manghai Cabu (I neh II) he a cuek vaengah pakhat lamni rhen a om. Israel kah khokhuen kawng te David tue lamloh Jerusalem poci tih Babylon la pilnam a poeng hil kah a kawng te a tael. Samuel cabu dongah tah Pathen olngai neh altha rhoek kawng te a tueng sak. Manghai cabu a pacuek dongah David kah a hnuktloih, Solomon manghai la om tih Jerusalem bawkim a saknah, a nawnnah kawng om. Cabu a rhakthuem vaengah tah Israel ram panit la a rheknah khawng, Tlangpuei te Israel ram, Tuithim te Judah ram la a om kawng a tael. Tonghma Elijah kah pongthohnah kawng a tael. 586-561

headers.im: Khokhuen Cabu a pacuek neh a pabae he lamhma ah pakhat lam ni a om. Adam lamkah a tong tih 538
headers.Babylon: vangsawn lamkah a mael uh hil kah Pathen pilnam kah khokhuen cil a rhui te a thuep. He cabu aka daek kung he mingpha pawt dae, Hebru olkah a hnonah ngawn bahoeng khuet, a tloe tloe kah cil ol te pakhat la a cului.
headers.dongkah: pakhat la a cului thai. Manghai David neh Manghai Solomon kawng he anah la a thui tih, bawknah hmuen khaw Jerusalem te a kungsut. He cabu loh olpuei la a thui tah, a tue he lang tih thovael mai cakhaw Pathen tah a pilnam taengah uepom la om. Uepom hlang te a bom te a tueng sak. Khokhuen Cabu a pacuek dongah Israel ca te vangsawn ah tamna la kum 70 om dae amah kho neh tukkainah a khueh uh yoeyah te a tael. Aboel pakhat lamloh parhet hil te Adam lamloh a rhuirhong kawng a tael. Aboel pako dongah tah Babylon lamkah aka mael rhoek kawng a tael. A tloe dongah tah Manghai David kah a kawng, a thaomnah, a boeimangnah a tael. A hnukhueng te David a dueknah neh Solomon Manghaila a tueknah kawng a thui.

headers.im: Khokhuen Cabu a pacuek neh a pabae he lamhma ah pakhat lam ni a om. Adam lamkah a tong tih 538
headers.Babylon: vangsawn lamkah a mael uh hil kah Pathen pilnam kah khokhuen cil a rhui te a thuep.He cabu loh olpuei la a thui tah, a tue he lang tih thovael mai cakhaw Pathen tah a pilnam taengah uepom la om. Uepom hlang Pathen loh a bom te diklai rammawtnah
headers.kawng: lakah a tueng sak. A thuem la Pathen bawknah neh Pathen taengah pilnamloh ol a kam te a tip la a thui. He cabu aka taelkung long he boe aka koek tlangpuei ram lakah
headers.taengah: uepom la aka om tuithim (Judah) kawng he a paelki. Jerusalem kah Bawkim aka sa Solomon kawng he a tip la a thui. 586
headers.vaengah: Babylon caem loh a muk uh tih sal la a khuennah kawng khaw a tueng sak. Cabu a bawtnah ah Persia Cyrus loh Judah hlang amah ram la a mael saknah kawng khaw a thui.

headers.515: vaengah tah Pathen taengla a nawn uh. Persian manghai Artaxerxes loh Babylon ah aka om Ezra te khosoih la, Pathen ol aka cangpueikung la a tueih. Jerusalem kah Israel ca kah bawknah te koep a thoh tih pilnam taengah Moses kah olkhueng te koep a tae pah. Ezra loh bawknah mawtkung te a coelh tih Judah hlang rhoek te ciim sak ham ol a khueh. Judah hlang loh kholong nu yunah pawt ham ol a paek.

headers.im: A cuekca vaengah Ezra neh Nehemiah he pakhat la om. He rhoi dongah he Pathen pilnam rhoek Babylon vangsawn lamloh a mael vaengkah, bawkim koep a saknah, Jerusalem a thohnah, amamih Pathen olkhueng dogla a kunnah kawng a tael. Aboel parhuk hil he Ezea loh vangsawn lamkah pilnam a maelnah kawng, Jerusalem ah hmueihtuk a saknah kawng,

headers.im: A cuekca vaengah Ezra neh Nehemiah he pakhat la om. He rhoi dongah he Pathen pilnam rhoek Babylon vangsawn lamloh a mael vaengkah, bawkim koep a saknah, Jerusalem a thohnah, amamih Pathen olkhueng dogla a kunnah kawng a tael. Aboel parhuk hil he Ezea loh vangsawn lamkah pilnam a maelnah kawng, Jerusalem ah hmueihtuk a saknah kawng,
headers.kongaih: la hmueih a nawn lamhmanah kawng a tael. Nehemiah loh Persian manghai Artaxerxes taengah boei a bi dae, Babylon vangsawn lamloh Jerusalem la aka mael pilnam kah a patangnah te a ming. Jerusalem khopuei vongka kaw boeih a hoeh uh tih vongtung khaw boeih rhawp coeng. Pathen taengah rhenah neh hoihaengnah ham a bih. Jerusalem kah khoboei bi ham neh khopuei koep sak ham khaw Artaxerxes taengah a bih thai. Tolrhum khoboei rhoek loh amah tloelh mai cakhaw hlang boeih a cului thai tih khopuei vongka neh vongtung khaw koep a thoh uh. Ezra loh pilnam hamla Moses olkhueng a tae pah, te vaengah tholh a phong uh, tun thangthui uh, boeipa kah khotue khaw koep a saii uh. Nehemiah long he thinom la bi a saii, Judah kah bawknah khaw pan a tlaih. Khlongnu khaw boeih a tueih, olkhueng loh a thui bangla Sabath khaw koep a tuem uh. Ezra neh Nehemiah cabu he 300

headers.im: Job cabu dongah he hlanghing kah patangnah kawng he a thui. Patangnah he tholhnah lamloh ha thoeng tih tholhnah phu ni Pathen loh hlang a patang sak. Cabu dongah he khat neh oldawtnah, hlatnah boeih te hlohlailung la a tael. Olkhueh Rhuem dongah tah Job cabu he olcueih ol la om. Job kah cil te a thui, anih hlang then la om tih Pathen a hinyahnah, boethae saii ham ngaih pawh. Te dae anih te a pumdongah puencakanh, patangnah neh a noemcai. Pathen kah tiktamnah te a dawt tih a laitloeknah khaw a coel, patang a bawtnah ham a bih. Job kah a hui rhoek long khaw amamih kah hmuhnah neh puet a thui uh van. Boeipa loh a thui taktak vaengah tah Pathen kah kopoekrhai neh a longpuei he hlang kah yakmingnah voelah ni a om, patangnah khuiah khaw Pathen thum tite a ming. Job he Boeipa kah yoethennah thai a dang tih camoe thai muep a cun, a khueh tawn khaw a pueh la yet. Joba cabu he 400

headers.im: Tingtoenglung he Greek ol la (Psalms) a ti. He kah cabu dongah laa, hlohli, tingtoenglung, thangthuinah rhen a tael. He cabu a tael he kum 500 tluk di ni. He olpuei la thangthuinah, thothuengnah neh Pathen koeh bawknah ham a mangtaeng. He cabu dongah he thinko lungbuei kah ngaihuetnah kothaenah neh omngaihngah, sungdaehnah neh ngaiuepnah, uepvawtnah neh ueppangnah, patangnah neh hloepnah, thintoeknah neh uehnah kawng a thui. Bible cabu dongah Tingtoenglung cabu dongah kah a yet koek koep a loh uh. Pathen uemonah neh koehnah kawng, khodaeng vaengah Pathen khuenah, rhal ta vaengah umponah kawng a thui. He cabu a yet ngai tah a boel la thui pawt tih cabu la a thui. Cabu a bawtnah takuem ah Amen, Amen neh a bawt sak. Tingtoenglung (Psalms) cabu he 400

headers.im: Olcueih cabu he Thuituen Ol
headers.cabu: bangla Jews rhoek kah olcueih ol pakhat la om. He cabu dongah Pathen loh lunglai a longim neh tlueptluep a suennah kawng, Pathen kah mangtaengnah neh hlanghing a bomnah kawng a tael. Israel ca rhoek kah olcueih aka om te boeih a coi tih tun a khueh. He kah dongah he pilnam kah khosaknah, khoboe rhamlang, omih kawng, mawtnah, imkhui sadingnah kawng, pilnam kah khosaknah kawng a thui. Cueinah a kung la Pathen om tih boethae halangnah a then pawt kawng te a thui. He boeih nen ni Pathen hinyahnah kawng a tueng thai a ti. Boethae halang loh hlang he pocinah lamni a mawt. Cueihnah loh Pathen taengah uepom la om tih, Boeipa hnukbang ham khaw a hoihaeng.

headers.im: Thuituennah Ol
headers.he: Judah rhoek thuidoeknah ol neh thuituennah la om. Hlang pakhat kah hingnah, awtkoi, thuidoeknah, hlohlai, olcueih neh khosaknah te a thui. Cabu ming he Hebrew ol lamtah
headers.a: ti tih, “Hloep a boel,” ke a thuingaihnah. Cadaekkung he saya, thuituenkung, khopoekkung la om. Joba cabu dongkah bangla he cabu dongah hlanghing cueihnah a rhimong omnah kawng a thui. Hmailong kah he Pathen long ni dawk a ming. Pilnam long he Pathen kah suennah olhuep he a tuuk thai moenih. Hingnah kawng he hlang loh yaming hamla a khuituk dae yakming lekpawh. Cabu dongah “A honghi,” tila puet a tael te hmuh vaengah hlang kah khuehtawn loh patangnah, dueknah, hnothae lamkah a tungaep thai moenih ti a tueng sak. Hing khosak dongkah aka thoeng he Pathen kut ah ni a om. A cuinah la , “Pathen hinyah lamtah boengai, hingnah a sang koek ni,” tila a thui. Olpuei tah mahyawn bueng poeknah neh diklai hno dongah tlungmu aih he a toel. He cabu 970-931

headers.im: Isaiah he Olkhueh Rhuem dongah tah a sen koek la om. Hlohlailung a dung ngai neh ngaiuepnah ol muep a tael. Isaiah he tuithim kah Judah ram kho a sak tih 742-698
headers.tluk: vaengah Pathen loh a voeknah te a thui. Isaiah dongkah a ngen tah 538
headers.vangsawn: lamkah a mael phoeiah a tael. Te dongah Isaiah he hlang panit pathum kah a tael te rhen a cong coini tila poeknah om. Judah khohmu rhoek loh Pathen kah tiktamnah neh sitlohnah, thinphoei lungvatnah te hlohlailung la muep a tael. Isaiah he hlop thum la a boel. A pacuek dongah tah pilnam loh Boeipa kah tungaepnah te uepnah pawt tih Moses kah olkhueng a hnawt dongah Pathen kah ollcaeknah a pai ham, thunkha loh a muk vetih amih a tuuk ham khaw a rhalrhing sak. can be divided into three parts. A pabae dongah tah vangsawn kah pilnam taengah ngaiuepnah te omngaih koehnah hlohlailung la a thui. Pathen loh pilnam te a ram la a mael puei vetih Jerusalem bawkim koep a sak uh ham khaw a thui pah. A hnukhueng kah dongah tah pilnam koep a thohnah, Boeipa kah khohnin thai a saenah kawng te a thui.

headers.im: Jeremiah dongah olphong, amah kawng, khokhuen, olthui boeih thum. He cabu he amah khokhuen kah aka thoeng hno dongkah te a thuicaih. A boel 36 hil he tah cabu he metla a culuinah ti te a thui. Pathen olthang thui ham la cadong ca a khuenah kawng te bitbit tueng. Jeremiah loh a hutnah te a doe tih Pathen kah uepom puencawn la naeh. Jeremiah loh a bibi he 627
headers.hil: phat a bi. Te vaengah Jerusalem te Babylon loh a loh coeng. Pathen tonghma la a om khuiah pilnam te Pathen taengah uepom la om ham a hoe, Judah te a rhalrhing sak. Pathen taeng lamkah aka hnukpoh Judah rhoek taengah oltak a thui dongah Jeremiah te a hnaemtaek uh. Anih te boekoek la a poek uh dongah a phaep uh, thong a hlak, a khoh uh, a boh uh phoeiah a ram lamloh a haek uh. Jeremiah loh tamna la aka cet pilnam taengah ngaiuepnah a thui, Israel neh Judah hamla olkhueh paipi thai a paek.

headers.im: Rhaengsae lung dongah he 586
headers.Jerusalem: bawkim a poci vaengah kosi a dung hlang la rhahnah la om. He hlohlai lung loh pocinah kawng bueng thui pawt tih, khopuei khopong kah khoponah te boeih a thui. Khopuei balaetih a poci ti kawng neh Pathen taengah rhennah a bih. Khopuei a a cungkunah kawng neh Jerusalem pilnam a cului kawng khaw a rhaengsae. A lung thumnah dongah tah khothae dung la ngai-uepnah a tlap. Pathen tah rhennah neh lungnah Boeipa, Pathen kah thinphatnah loh patang a bawt sak kawng a thui. A pali dongah ah rhihnah, sundaehnah, tlayaenah neh tawnbanah kawng a sak. A hnukkhueng ah tah Jerusalem pilnam ham rhennah bih tih thaduengthai sai sak ham a bih.

headers.im: Babylonia lo Jerusalem he kum 597
headers.vaengah: anih he Pathen loh a pilnam rhoek ham tonghma la a khue. Lamhma ah Ezekiel long he Pathen loh a pilnam ol a caek vetih, namtu hlangtholh, halang mawtkung, laithae tonghma rhoek a thiinah kawng a thui. Te phoeiah tah diklai namtom hlang soah Pathen kah laitloeknah a pai kawng te a thui. Lammah atah ol a thui ham khaw tonga ngawn coeng dae Jerusalem a cungku vaengah tah Pathen loh Ezekiel te koep a cal sak. Pathen Mueihla he hlang duek taengah khaw kun vetih a ram la koep mael ham khaw a hmuh sak. Pathen Bawkim thai neh thangpomnah ham khaw a hmuh sak.

headers.im: Daniel cabu he olcueih cabu la om tih tonghma ol, khokhuen cil, hmalong mangthui kawng khaw a tael. Lamhma kah a boel dongah he Babylon vangsawn ah aka om Hebrew hoel Daniel neh a hui rhoek kawng a thui. Daniel neh a hui rhoek tah Pathen kut dongah uepom la om tih a mih Babylon ah cueihnah a then la a cangpuei. Daniel tah bahoeng cueih tih hlang loh a ming mueh mang khaw boeih a thuicaih thai. Nebuchadnezzar kah hmaihueng khui lamkah khaw Pathen loh Daniel neh a hui rhoek te a khang. Daniel he hlang loh a uet tih phae hamla a taeng dongah Daniel te sathueng khui la a voeih. Tedae Pathen loh Daniel koep a khang. Daniel loh mang a hmuh te Pathen caeltueih loh koep a thuicaih pah. Lunglai boeih aka tu kung tah Pathen ni ti a thui. Ramtloe kah uknah hmuiah aka om a pilnam te Pathen ngaiuepnah neh a hloep.

headers.vaengah: a thui. Amos he Judah ram tuithim ah a cun dae Pathen loh tlangpuei kah Israel ram la ol thui ham a tueih. Syria, Philistia, Phoenicia, Edom, Ammon, Moab, neh Judah he a cawh vetih dan a tat ni. Tedae Israel hlanglen rhoek loh khodaeng neh mangdaeng te a yoop dongah amih soah kah dantatnah kawng te a sen la a thui. Israel sokah laitloeknah kawng te othang panga a tueng sak. Kaisih loh buh boeih a yoop ni, diklai pum te hmai loh boeih a hlawp ni. Mikrhael rhui a toe te khaw Israel ca rhoek he Pathen kah uepomnah tangtlaeng dongah hing pawh a ti. Voeihang dongah kah thaihhmin loh Israel ca rhoek a poci ham yoei coeng a ti. Bethel im neh bawkkung rhoek khaw cungku pawn ni a ti. Israel ca rhoek te namtom taengah taekyak la om ni. A hnukkhueng ah ngaiuepnah om, ram te koep a thoh vetih pilnam khaw hoeih ni.

headers.im: Jonah cabu he Bible dongah a tloe tonghma rhoek neh vai uh pawh. Jonah he a tloe tonghma olphong bangla om pawh. He tah Pathen kah a khuenah neh tonghma loh a oeinah kawng he kungpuei la a thui. A lungdueng la thui koinih Pathen kah lungnah tah hlangboeih ham he a rhal rhoek ham pataeng om. Assyria kho Nineveh he a tholh phu dantat ham a om coeng dongah cet lamtah thui pah a ti nah. Pathen ol a ngai kolla tuisangpho dongah ng Sapain (Tarshish)ng* la yong. Pathen loh hlipuei a tloh tloe la a tueih pa tih tuisangpho khaw dalh buek. Jonah loh Pathen ol a ngai pawt dongah ni hlipuei loh tui sangpho dalh a buek sak tila kholong pathen aka bawk rhoek loh a ming. Te dongah Jonah kah Pathen
headers.te: a bawk uh tih Jonah khaw tuili khuila a voeih uh. Te vaengah Pathen loh khohli khaw a paa sak tih Jonah dolh hamla nga a tueih. Nga ko khuiah thangthui tih nga loh tuikaeng la a thaa. Te phoeah Nineveh la cet tih Pathen ol te a pang puei. Khopuei khaw yut tih Pathen loh tholh a hlah pah. A hnukkhueng ah Pathen kah sitlohnah kawng te Jonah a cangpuei.

headers.im: Tonghma Habakkuk he ram a hinghong
headers.tue: vaengah kho a sak. Ram tlung Assyria neh Babylon kah tanah laklo kah Judah tah halangnah neh huencannah khaw muep yet. Tiktamnah mueh kawng dongah Job bangla Habakkuk loh Pathen te phaeng a tueng sak. Judah ah halangnah a om pawt hamla Boeipa taengah a bih. Judah dantat hamla Pathen loh Babylon a tueih pah. Habakkuk tah let coeng Babylon hlangtholh loh me tlamlae a a then aih a ti. Babylon kah a thae te Pathen loh a ueh tloel coeng dongah dan a tat. Pathen kongaih a vai pawt dongah Judah te ana mawn laeh saeh a ti. Pathen loh pilnam a khang vetih thaomnah a paek pawn ni.

headers.im: Tonghma Zephaniah loh Boeipa kah Khohnin puei ham a rhalrhing sak. Te tah a ol aka ngai pawt rhoek boeih dantat hamla Pathen kah khohnin kawng ni. Zephaniha taengkah ol aka pai he Pathen kah muei loh a cahoehnah neh a tong. Diklai mulhing boeih, pilnma neh rhamsa khaw, vaa neh nga khaw amah loh a suen dae a phae pawn ni. Boeipa kah khohnin he buengrhuet ha pai koeloe pawn ni. Amah aka bawk tih tlayae rhoek boeih a hnukkhueng hil ah daem ni. Boeipa taengah uepom hlang rhoek long tah Jerusalem la koep bal ni. Amih loh Boeipa kah tanah te umponah a khueh uh ni.

headers.im: Persia manghai Cyrus loh Jews pilnam te Babylon tamna lamloh Jerusalem la a mael sak tih bawkim khaw koep a thoh sak. Pilnam loh bawkim a sak hlan ah amamih im te a sak dongah Pathen ol te a caeh pah. Pathen loh Zerubbabel ham khaw, Judah khoboei rhoek ham khaw, khosoih Joshua ham khaw Haggai taengah a thui pah. Pathen bawkim te a sak hlan khuiah tah Judah rhoek he thaihtak mahpawh tila Haggai loh rhalrhing a paek. Bawkim te a sak daengah nih Boeipa loh pilnam a bom vetih kho a buh eh, rhalmongnah neh a yoe a then eh. A hnukkhueng ah tah Jerusalem pilnam loh bibi te a tong uh. Pathen loh ram kah khoboei la Zerubbabel te a tuek. Anih loh ram a thoh tih ram tloe te a thup.

headers.im: Tonghma Zekhariah lohng he Babylon lamkah aka mael Judah rhoek taengah Pathen ol a thui. A thawnpuei Haggai bangla a pilnam te Pathen uepnah neh bawkim koep thoh ham a thui pah. Zekhariah amah hmai kah Israel tonghma rhoek bangla Judah rhoek kah thothueng a dueng neh, mawtkung rhoek kah langyanah om ham te a thui. Pilnam thaphohnah hamla Zekhariah loh Boeipa lamkah mangthui parhet a hm uh. Pathen kah lungnah a cak sak tih, Jerusalem neh pilnam te a tungaep. Israel kah thangpomnah neh thadueng lamhmai te koep a thoelh. Zerubbabel te Judah khoboei la om vetih Joshua te khosoih la om ni. Cabu pabae dongah tah hmailong thunkha dantatnah khaw, pilnam a hlawt vetih koep a culuinah kawng, Israel boeilu a thaphohnah kawng, Jerusalem te Boeipa kuepkolnah hmuen la a omnah kawng a thui.

headers.515: vaengah Jerusalem bawkim te a sak uh coeng dae ta Pathen kah olkam neh yoethennah tah vikvik aka hla bangla om. He bang khuiah he tonghma Malakhi loh khosoih rhoek kah a pamdah neh a ngaithuen pawt dongah Pathen kah thintoek a pai ham te a thui. Pilnam khaw Pathen taeng lamloh phael uh tih a thuem la Pathen taengah nawn uh pawh. Malkhi long tah pilnam loh khodaeng a ming he Pathen taengkah hnukpoh dongah aka thoeng ni a ti. Tedae Pathen loh a pilnam a lungnah te a thovael moenih, Boeipa aka hinyah tih a ming aka thangpom tah kutdoe a dang ni a ti. Boeipa kah khohnin a pai ham kawng neh te Malkhi loh ol a bawt sak. Te khohnin ah Pathen loh halang hlang te dan a tat vetih, uepom hlang te a hoeih sak ni. Puencawn la tonghma Elijah ha pai vbetih a pilnam lungnah khui la a mawt ni a ti. Malkhi cabu he

headers.im: Tobit cabu dongah he bawknah yancil olbangla cueihnah kawng muep a tael. Tobit he Israel hlang uepom hlang la om dae Assyria ram Nineveh ah tamna la a khuen uh. Israel ram he Assyria loh BC 722 vaengah a loh. Hekah cabu loh olpuei n'cang puei tah; Pathen taengah uepom la om ham, khodae lungma bomcen ham, manu napa hinyah ham a kuek kawng a thui. Rhainah, dantatnah neh noemcai mai cakhaw Pathen tah thangthuinah rhoirhi kung Pathen la om. Amah taengah uepom la aka om tah anih ham Pathen khaw uepom la om van ni.
headers.ip: A pabae ah Ecbatana kah Israel nu hula ca Sarah kawng te a thui. Anih te va sak dae imbuh a cah hlaem ah rhaithae a va te vikvik a ngawn pah. Te dongah a va parhih hil a duek pah. Tobit neh Sarah kah thangthuinah te Pathen loh a hnatun dongah Tobit capa Tobias neh vaan puencawn Raphael te Pathen loh a tueih pah. Pathen loh ka thangthuinah hnatun pawt mai coini n'ti vaengah khaw thangthuinah dongah uepom la pai ham he olpuei la a thui. Tobit cabu he tah AD 70 tluk ah tael mai coini a ti.

verses.text: He cabu long tah Naphtali koca, Asiel cadil, Rhaphel capa Gabael aka a ca Aduel capa, Haniel capa Tobiel kah a capa Tobit kah cil kawng te a thui

Anih tah Assyria kah manghai Shamnesrt tue vaengah Thisbe lamloh Phogor tlangpuei khotlak kah Asher kungkueng a so Galilee kah Naphtali Kehdesth tuithim ah tamna la a khuen.   
\s1 Tobit kah A Rhoengnah

Kai, Tobit tah ka hing tue khuiah ah oltak neh duengnah longpuei ah ni ka pongpa. Assyria khohmuen kah Nineveh ah vangsawn la aka cet ka pilnam taeng neh ka manuca taengah khaw sitlohnah bibi he muep ka saii.

Kamah khohmuen Israel kho ah ka om vaengah camoe la ka om pueng. Te vaengah a pa Naphtali loh Jerusalem neh David imkhui te a thoh. Khopuei te tah Israel koca boeih khui lamloh a tuek coeng. Teah te Israel koca boeih loh hmueih nawn saeh. Teah tah Pathen om nah bawkim om. Te te kumhal kah cadilcahma boeih ham a ciim tih a thoh coeng
Israel manghai Jeroboam loh Dan neh Galilee tlang boeih a nawn vaito ca te ka manuca neh Naphtali imkhui kah a pa rhoek loh a bawk uh coeng.

Kai kamah bueng ni Jerusalem kah khoning vaengah khaw ka cet. Tetah kumhal kah oltloek neh Israel boeih hamla a saii coeng. Ka thaicuek neh, boiva dukcuek neh, saelhung parha pakhat neh, tu mul a rhuep cuek neh Jerusalem la ka cet paitok

Hmueihtuk kah Aaron koca, khosoih rhoek te he ni ka paek eh. Canghum parha pakhat, misurtui, olive situi, talae thaih, thaibu neh thingthaih boeih te Jerusalem kah bi aka bi Levi koca taengah ka pae eh. A kum rhuk dongah khaw parha ah panit te ka tung tih Jerusalem la ka caeh vaengah ka tael eh.

Parha ah pathum tah cadah nuhmai neh amah Israel hlang la aka coeng hlang rhoek hamla ka tael pah. Te te ka khuen tih a kum thum dongah amih hamla ka tael pah. Te tah a pa Tobiel manu, Deborah kah oluen bangla, Moses kah olkhueng oltloek bangla ka caak. Kai khaw a pa duek tih cadah lam ni kai n'khueh.

Hlang la ka poeh vaengah tah ka huiko khuii lamkah te ka yuu la ka loh. Anih rhangneh kai he Tobias ka sui, tongpa pakhat kah a napa la ka poeh.   
\s1 Nineveh La a Khuen
Assyria ah tamna la n'khuen tih Nineveh ah khaw tamna la ka om. Te vaengah ka huiko boeih te ka pilnam loh namtom kah buh te a caak.
Tedae kai tah namtom kah buh aka ca khui lamloh ka cue uh.
Ka hingnah boeih neh Pathen aka poek la ka om dongah.
Khohni loh kai tah Shalmaneser taengah khaw kolonah neh hnothen ni m'paek.
Anih a dueknah rhi Media la ka cet tih anih hamla ka thenpom pah. Media khohmuen kah ka om vaengah Gabri manuca Gabael taengah tangka sungkoi, talen parha aka ting te ka khueh pah.

Tedae Shalmaneser a duek vaengah tah a capa Sennkherih te anih yuengla manghai. Te vaengah Media longpuei tah rhih om coeng tih ka cet voel pawh.   
\s1 Thinom neh Rhok Vueinah
Shalmaneser tue vaengah he ka pilnam neh ka huiko taengah sitlohnah bih he muep ka saii.
Ka buh te bungpong taengah, ka himbai te pumtling taengah ka paek. Nineveh vong hilp kah a voeih ka pilnam kah duek rhok te ka hmuh vaengah ka khoem pah.

Judea lamloh aka yong tih Sennakherib loh a duek sak rhoek kah rhok te khaw ka khoem pah. Te vaeng tue ah anih te amah kah salphamnah vanbangla vaan kah manghai loh a duek sak. A thintoek dongah Israel ca muep a duek sak. Tedae a huep la rhok ka khuen tih ka up. Te rhoek te Sennakherib loh a tlap dae a hmuh moenih.

Te dongah Nineveh hlang pakhat te cet tih manghai taengah kai kawng a thui. Te dongah kamah khaw ka thuh uh. Manghai loh kai kawng a ming tih kai duek sak ham n'tlap te ka ming vaengah tah ka rhih tih ka yong.
Ka koerhang boeih te khaw hang rhawt. Pakhat kangna khaw paih pawh. A cungkuem te manghai koe la a loh tih ka yuu Anna neh ka capa Tobias bueng te sueng.

Tedae khohnin likip a koe hlan ah Sennakherih te a ca rhoi loh a ngawn tih Ararat tlang la a yong tak rhoi. Te phoeiah tah a capa Esarhadon te anih yuengla manghai. Anih long tah ka manuca Hanael capa, Ahikat te a tuek tih ram tom kah boeih kah a soah a khueh. Uktaemnah boeih soah saithainah khaw anih te a paek.

Anih loh kai n'tungaep dongah Nineveh la ka mael. Te vaengah Ahikat tah tultael boeih, kutcin boei neh Assyria manghai Sennakherib kut hmuikah taemrhainah boeih aka hutnah la om. Te dongah Esarhadon te koep a tuek. Anih tah ka ca la om tih ka huiko rhep la om.

Esarhadon a manghai tue vaeng ah im la ka mael. te vaengah ka yuu Anna neh ka capa Tobias tah kai aka doe la om. Te vaengah yalhkhat khotue kah aka cim, Pentekos khotue om. Te dongah kai hamla hlaembuh han tawn uh tih caak hamla ka vael.

Kai hamla caboei a tloeng uh vaengah ka mikhmuh ah caak muep han tawn. Te dongah ka capa Tobias te, “Ka capa, cet lamtah Niniveh tamna lakli kah mah pilnam boeih te toem lamtah hang khuen. Pathen dongah lungbuei boeih aka hong rhoek te. Anih te kamah taengah buh hmaih ka ca eh. Na voei duela kang rhing ni,” ka ti nah.

Te dongah Tobias te ka pilnam khodaeng rhoek te toem hamla cet. Anih te ha mael vaengah tah, “A pa,” a ti tih, “Kai ka om, ka ca,” ka ti nah. Te dongah a caeh doela, “A pa, mah pilnam rhoek te a ngawn tih hnoyoih hmuen ah a voeih coeng ne. Te dongah daprhok lah yalh uh coeng,” a ti.
Te dongah ka tho tih ka buh pataeng ka ten koll la ka nong. Te dongah a rhok te up hamla khotlak hil toltung lamloh ka coi.
Ka mael phoei tah tui ka hluk tih kothae neh buh ka caak.

Te vaengah Amos kah tonghma ol loh Bethel a phong thil tih, “Na khotue kho rhaengsaenah la poeh vetih, Na laa te khaw rhaengsae lung la poeh ni,”  
\m a ti te ka poek. Te dongah ka rhap.   
\s1 Tobit Mikdael La Poeh
Khomik a tlak nen tah ka cet tih hlan ka too phoeiah rhok te ka up.
Te vaengah ka imben rhoek loh n'nueih thil tih, “Anih he rhih mahnim? He tah, he he a saii dongah duek hamla la a hloem coeng dae ta. Anih yong coeng dae ca, rhok koep a up bal pueng,” a ti uh.
Tekah hlam tah tui ka hluk, ka imkawt la ka cet. Te vaengah vongup kah pangbueng taeh ka yalh. Tedae kho ling tih ka maelhmai tah ka khuk pawh.

Te vaengah pangbueng sola vahnup a om te ka ming pawh. A sa te ka mik khui ah daeng tih a bok cala a hlip om. Te dongah toi hamla Si boei ka paan. Tedae si neh muep a toi vaengah a lip a bok loh kamik ta aep a dah. Ka khaw yip dael. Kum li khui ah kho ka hmu pawh. Ka huiko boeih khaw kai hamla a ko thae uh. Ahikar long khaw Elymais la a caeh hlankah kum nit khuiah tah kai n'khut.   
\s1 Tobit Yuh Loh Bungkhutnah A Tlap
Te vaeng tue ah tah ka yuu Anna long khaw huta bibi neh tangka a tlap.

Anih loh a saii noek bangla amah loh a saii te a kungmah rhoek taengla a thak tih anih te khaw thapang a paek uh. Hnin at tah, Dystruss kah a rhihnah dongah a himbai te a ah tih a kungmah rhoek taengla a thak bal. Te vaengah anih te thapang a muep a paek tih hlaembuh hamla maae ca a paek bal.

Ka taengla hala vaengah maae te koe a hlaih. Te dongah amah te ka khue tih, “Me lam kah maae nim nang khuen he? Na huen pawt nim? A kungmah taengla thak laeh. A huen boeih he tah caak ham la hamsum a om moenih,” ka ti nah.

Tedae anih loh kamah taengah, “Te tah ka thapang soah kutdoe lamni m'paek,” a ti. Te dae anih ka tangnah pawt dongah a kungmah taengla thak hamla ka thui pah. Te dongah anih taengah khaw ka thintoek te sai coeng. Te vaengah anih loh kai te, “Bothen na sai te melam ni a om, duengnah khoboe na saii te menim? The rhoek he nang aka ming la om coeng,” a ti.
\s1 Tobit Kah Thangthuinah
Te vaengah muep kothae neh ka thinko khaw thiip tih ka rhap. Ka rhungrhah neh thangthui hamla ka tong;
BOEIPA namah tah duengnah la na om tih, na khoboe boeih khaw a tiktam la om. Na longpuei khaw sitlohnah neh oltak la om, namah loh diklai khaw lai na tloek tih.

Te dongah aw BOEIPA, kai he m'poek lah, Kai he kolo la n'so lah. Ka tholnah neh ka poek mueh kah boei thai boeih khaw han cawh boel mai. Te rhoek te a pa rhoek loh na mikhmuh a saii uh. Nang taengah tholh uh coeng tih, m

Na olpaek te ngai uh pawh. Te dongah kaimih ta aka poelyoe taengla, tamna neh dueknah ongah nan voeih, Te dongah hlang aka thui la, ol la, kokhahnah la ka om uh. Namtong boeih taeng khaw kaimih he nan taekyaak.

Namah kai tlaitloeknah tah muep thuem coeng, Kai lamkah ka tholnah dongah cawhnah khaw buelh thoeng coeng. Na olpaek te ka tuem uh pai pawt tih, Na mikhmuh ah oltak dongah khaw ka pongpa uh pawh.   
\b

Te dongah na kongaih bangla kai taengah saii, Kai lamkah ka mueihla he loh hamkhaw ol pae mai. Te daengah ni laipi la aka om kai he diklai maelhmai lamloh ka daem eh. Kai hamtah hing lakah duek he ni hnothen la a om mai coeng. A tingtawk pawt kah kokhahnah khaw ka hnatun mai coeng. Ka khuiah kothaenah muep hah coeng. Aw BOEIPA, ol pae lamtah he citcai lamloh ka loeih mai eh. Dungyan im la caeh ham kai n'hlawt lah. Aw BOEIPA, na maelhmai te kai taenglam loh mangthung boeh. Kai hamtah duek he hnothen la om mai coeng. Te dongah ka hingnah citcai he muep ka hmu lah ve kokhahnah he ya lah ve.   
\s1 Sarah A Khotohnah Tholh
Te khohnin ah Media kah Ecbatana ah Raguel canu Sarah kah kawng khaw om bal. Anih te a napa kah salnu loh a soehsal.

Anih te a va parhih a khueh. A yuu kah khosing bangla anih te a khueh uh coeng dae amih mikhmuh ah rhaithae halang Asmodes loh boeih a ngawn pah. Te dongah anih te salnu loh, “Na va rhoek aka ngawn khaw nang ni. Va parhih na khueh dae amih khuikah pakhat ming ham khaw ca na sak pah moenih.

Balaetih kai mih nan boh? Na va rhoek te a duek dongah nim? Amih taengla cet laeh, na canu neh na capa khaw ka hmuh uh voel boel mai eh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.   
\s1 Sarah kah Thangthuinah

Te khohnin ah anih te mueihla neh nguekcoi tih rhap. Te phoeiah anapa kah imhman la luei tih amah kuiok ham cai. Tedae amah te poek uh tih, “A pa te kokhahnah uh voel boel saeh. A nih te, ‘Canu oingaih cangloeng la na khueh dae a ngaihmang ah mah kuiok coeng,’ ti uh lah ve. Te dongah a pa te a patong soi ah kothae neh saelkhui la ka suntlak sak lah ve. Ka kuiok pawt he kai ham hnothen la om coeng. Tedae BOEIPA taengah ka thangthui vetih ka duek mai bitni. Te vaengah he kokhahnah ka ya voel mahpawh,” a ti.

Amah te vaengah a kut te bangbuet ah a doh tih thangthui. Te vaengah, Rhennah Pathen namah tah na yoethen pai, Na ming khaw kumhal duela a yoethen pai, Na bibi boeih loh namah te kumhal n'koeh pai saeh.   
\b
Te dongah BOEIPA nang taengla maelhmai ka hoi coeng,
Ka mik khaw saeh namah taengla kang huel coeng Diklai lamloh ka daem ham ol pae laeh Te bang kokhahnah te ka ya voel boel eh.
Aw Boeipa, ka ommongsitoe he na ming coeng, Hlang aka poeih khui lamloh khaw,

Ka ming he ming thae ka khueh moenih, Ka vangsawn khohmuen kah a pa ming he khaw, Kai tah a pa kah khuehduen ca la ka om, Anih loh a pang ham camoe khaw om pawh, Anih loh huiko neh cakoparhaeng a khueh moenih, U long nim kai n'yunah lah ve? Ka va parhih la rhen duek uh coeng. Balae ka hing thil eh? Te ni na ngaih pawt oeh atah, BOEIPA aw, ka hingnah he lo mai Kai kah yahpohnah he hnatun lah,”   
\s1 Thangthuinah A Rhoi Pah
Te vaengah amih rhoi kah thangthui nah te vaan ah Pathen mikhmuh ah thangpomnah la a yaak pah.

Te dongah Rhaphael te a tuei pah tih amih rhoi te a hoeih sak. Tobit te khaw a mik dongkah a lip te a khoe pah. Te phoeiah tah Pathen kah vangnah te amik neh a hm uh. Raguel canu Sarah te khaw Tobit capa Tobias neh yuva rhoi ham a pae. Te dongah halang rhaithae Asmodes taeng lamloh loeih sak a khueh. Oltak dongah aka saii rhoek boeih tah a saii boeih dongah thaihtak ni. Duengnah aka saii rhoek boeih te khaw.

Te daengah ni na kueknah hnin ah tah namah hamla kawn then na tung eh.

\s1 Gabael Taengkah Tangka Khueh
Ka capa aw, Media Rages kah Gabrias capa Gabael taengah tangka talen parha ka khueh te nang taengah kan thui mai pawn eh.
Ka capa khaw khodaeng la ng'om uh akhaw rhih boeh. Pathen te na rhih atah boeinah a lenkoek na khueh ni. Te dongah tholnah cungkuem lamloh yong lamtah BOEIPA na Pathen mikhmuh a then mah saii laeh.
Te phoeiah Tobias loh a napa Tobit te, “A pa kai nan uen bangla boeih ka saii bitni.

Tedae metlam lae anih taengkah tangka te ka dang eh. Anih loh kai m'ming pawt tih kai long khaw anih ka ming moeh nih. Mebang mingphanah nim anih te ka paek vetih m'ming eh. Kai n'tangnah vetih kai te tangka m'paek venim? Media longpuei te ka ming bal pawt tih, te te metlam ka pha eh?” a ti nah.

Te vaengah Tobit loh a capa Tobias te, “A nih loh kai pinnah m'paek tih anih khaw pinnah ka paek coeng. Te te panit la ka boe tih rhakthuem ah ka loh rhoi. Rhakthuem te tangka neh ka khueh pah. Anih taengah tangka ka khueh te kum kul a poeng coeng. Te dongah ka capa, uepom hlang te tlap lamtah namah neh cet rhoi. Na mael rhoi vaengah anih te thapang m'paek bitni. Gabael taeng lamkah tangka mah ham bal puei dae,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te dongah Tobias te cet tih hlang pakhat, longpuei aka ming te Media la amah neh caeh ham a tlap. A caeh hatah a hmai ah puencawn Raphael a pai te a hm uh. Tedae anih te Pathen kah puencawn la hmat pawh.

Tobias loh anih te, “Cadong pa, me lamkah nim na loh?” “Israel ca khuikah uh hoel lae?” a ti nah. Anih te, “He la bibi sai hma ka lo he,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. Te phoeiah Tobias loh anih te, “Media la aka cet longpuei te na ming a?” a ti nah.

“Ka ming ta, teah te a tue a sen ka om ta, te te ka hmat tih longpuei khaw boeih ka ming. Media la puet ka cet coeng. Media Rages kah Gabael khaw mah huiko ni. Anih taengah khaw puet ka om coeng. Ecbatan lamloh Rage tah hnin nit longcaeh ah om. Te tah tlang rhoek laklo ah om tih, Ecbatatah kolbawn laklo ah om,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Te dongah Tobias loh anih te, “Cadong pa, kai n'rhing dae, A pa taengah ka thui mai dae eh. Kai he nang neh hmai caeh ham ka ngaihnah om. Na thapang kam paek bitni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
“Kang rhing bitni, tedae muep koe boeh ne,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te dongah Tobias te a napa taengah thui hamla cet tih a mah taengah, “Hlang pakhat ka hmuh coeng, anih te mah Israel ca khuikah ni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. Te vaengah, “Ka capa aw, anih te khue lamtah a cako kawng khaw, mebang a khueh tih, nang neh na caeh ham khaw meyet nim a uep om tih khaw ka ming lah eh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te dongah Tobias te cet tih anih te a khue. Te vaengah, “Cadong pa, a pa loh nang n'khue,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. Tedae Tobit loh, “Kai hamla mebang omngaihnah nim nang khueh? Kai tah khosae aka hmuh mueh hlang la ka om. Vaan kah khosae khaw ka hmu voel pawh. A hmuep ah hlang duek bangla ka yalh. Vangnah khaw ka hmuh voel pawh. Ka hing dae aka duek lakli ah ka yalh. Pilnam kah ol te ka yaak dae ka hmuh hae pawh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.  
 Te dongah cadong pa loh, “Na rhalthen sak, Pathen tah nang hoeih sak hamla ha tawn uh coeng, na rhalthen sak,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.  
 Tobit loh anih te, “Ka capa Tobias he Media la caeh a ngaih. Anih te na puei tih na tueng thai aya? Ka manca aw, thapang kam paek bitni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.  
 Anih long khaw, “Anih te ka caeh puei thai bitni, long boeih ka ming. Media te ka cet noek tih van te khaw boeih ka lan coeng. Tlang neh longpuei rhoek boeih ka hmat ngawn,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Te dongah Tobit loh, “Manuca nang, na imkhuikho ta mekah nim? Namah koca ta meka nim? Manuca nang thui lah,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Tedae anih loh, “Balae tih kai koca te ming na ngaih?” a ti nah.  
 Tedae Tobit loh, “Manuca nang, nang u capa nim, na ming u nim? ti khaw rhep ming ka ngaih tih,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
“Kai tah namah huiko, Hanaiah puei kah capa Azariah ni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te dongah Tobit loh anih te, “Manuca nang kan uem, Pathen loh n'khang coeng. Kai taengah olkhaa lamkhaw poek boel mai ne manuca. Kai tah nangkah a khuui te rhep ming ka ngaih. Te dongah ka huiko la na om khaw, hlang then neh hlang rhoei rhuirhong la na om khaw thui lah. Shemeliah ca rhoi Hananiah neh Nathan te ka ming ta. Amih rhoi te kai neh Jerusalem la ka puei tih tho ka thueng uh ta. Longpuei khaw a phaelh rhoi moenih. Nang tah pilnam then kah huikoi pai nih. Nang tah bawn then khui lamloh na lo pai. Te phoeiah, “Nang te hnin at thapang la drakma pakhat kam paek bitni. Namah neh ka capa loh na hnonah rhoi ham khaw. Te phoeiah na thapang khaw bet kan tom bitni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Raphael loh, “Anih te ka caeh puei bitni. Sading la ka cet rhoi vetih sading la ka mael bitni. Longpuei khaw a dingsuek la om om,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Tobit loh anih te, “Manuca nang soah yoethennah om saeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.  
 Te phoeiah a capa te a khue tih amah taengah, “Ka capa, longpueng hamla lampu cun lamtah na manuca neh hlah uh saeh. Vaan dongkah Pathen loh te lamte sading la n'khuen saeh. Kai taengah sading la ha mael. Ka capa nang te amah kah puencawn loh longpuei tah sading la m'puei saeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.  
 A caeh hamla a tong vaengah a manu a napa te a mok. Tobit loh anih te, “Longpueng ah sading la ne,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Tedae a manu tah pahoi rhap tih Tobit te, “Balae tih camoe te vik na tueih. Anih la mah rhoi loh n'conghol nah tih, mamih hmai ah a caeh moenih a?
Tangka so tangka koep poep boeh. Te te mah ca kah tlansum la om mai saeh.
BOEIPA loh mamih rhoi hingnah m'paek he tah mamih rhoi ham rhoeh coeng,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Tobit loh anih te, “Mawn boeh; mah ca te tah sading la cet tih, sading la ha voei bitni. Sading la ha voei vaengah khaw na mik loh a hmuh bitni. Thui voel boeh. Amih rhoi ham khaw mawn boeh ka ngannu.
Puencawn then loh anih a puei vetih a yincaeh khaw thaihtak bitni. Te dongah sading la ha voei bitni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

\s1 Rages La Caehnah  
 Cadong te a caeh van neh puencawn khaw anih taengah cet.
Te vaengah a taengkah ui te halo tih amih rhoi te a caeh puei. Te phoeiah longpuei te phat te uh. Lamhma cuek hlaem ah amih rhoi te Tigris tuiva ah rhaeh rhoi.
Te vaengah cadongah suntla tih Tigris tuiva ah a kho a silh. Te vaengah nga a lennu te tui khui lamloh a cungpet tih ca dongkah a kho te dolh hamla a cai dongah anih khaw pang.
Tedae puencawn loh cadong, “Nga te kop lamtah dingkoei pah,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. Te dongah cadong pa loh nga te a kop tih lan so la a voeih.

Tedae puencawn loh cadong te, “Nga te phak boe lamtah a kuel, a then, a hmuet te loh pah. Te rhoek te namah taengah khoem. A rhil te voei. A hmuet, a thin, a kuel te si la hnonah om,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te dongah cadong pa loh nga te phak a boe tih a hmuet, a thin neh a kuel te a loh. Te phoei ah nga te a hak. Rhakthuem te a caak tih rhakthuem te baek hamla a khueh. Te phoeiah tah amih rhoi khaw a caeh longpuei ah phat cet rhoi tih Media neh a yoeinah ah om rhoi coeng.
Te vaengah cadong pa loh puencawn te a dawt tih, “Manuca Azariah, nga kah a hmuet, thin neh a kuel dongah mebang si nim ca aka om?” a ti nah.

Te dongah, “Rhai neh mueihla thae loh a hnaem taek tongpa khaw, huta khaw a hmai ah nga ka a hmuet, a thin ne a kut a khu la hlut pah. Te vaengah tloh te vil yong vetih te kah hlang taengah koep om voel mahpawh.

Hlang mik te khomai loh a cun vaengah nga hmuet nen te koelh pah. A khomai so ah ueng pah lamtah a mik te hoeih bitni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.   
\s1 Raphael kah Uentonah

Te vaengah Rhaphael loh cadong pa te, “Manuca Tobias,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. “Heah ka om,” a ti nah van. Te phoeiah tah Raphael loh anih te, “Tihin hlaem tah Raguel im ah n'rhaeh rhoi pawn ni. Anih he mah huiko la om. Anih he canu pakhat Sarah a sui te a khueh.

Sarah bueng phoeiah tah canu a tloe, capa a tloe khaw anih loh a khueh moenih. A napa kah khuehtawn aka pang te nang ham khaw then coeng. Te phoeiah he hutah cueih, a rhal then, a hlang bahoeng then tih a napa khaw hlang then la om,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te phoeiah, “Anih na yuunah te boeih thuem coeng. Te dongah ka mana nang, kai ol he hnatun. Hlaem ah huta kawng te a napa taengah ka thui bitni. Te vaengah anih he nang ham nungak la khuet sieh. Rages la m'mael vaengah anih lueinah te saii saih. Raguel loh nang ham te hloh loengloeng mahpawh tila ka ming. Moses cabu dongkah oltloek bangla dueknah oltloek a om pawt tah anih te a tloe ham kam pa mahpawh. Anih loh nang te hlang tloe boeih lakah rhep m'ming ta. A canu yunah sak ham khaw a moeh ta. Te dongah kam mana nang hnatun. Hlaem ah huta kawng te thui sih lamtah bae hamla khueh sih. Te dongah Rages lamloh m'mael vaengah khaw anih te mah rhoi loh nang imla khuen sih,” a ti nah

Te vaengah Tobias loh Raphael te, “Ka maya Azariah, anih te a va voei rhih a sak dae yulueinah imkhan ah pahoi duek tila ka yaak coeng ta. Hlaem ah anih te aka kun tah duek ni ta. Rhaithae loh amih te a ngawn tila pilnam loh a thui khaw ka yaak ta.

Amah soah tah a thae khaw saii pawt dae anih taengah caeh aka ngaih boeih te a ngawn. Te dongah, kai a pa loh capa khat bueng lamni ng'khueh. Kai tah ka rhih. Lueinah im khan la na kun vaengah nga kah a kuel neh a thin te bet khuen lamtah imkhan kah botui dongah khueh.

A hmuehmueih te a rhim vaengah rhai te a uet vetih yong bitni. A taengah khaw na hmuh voel mahpawh. Anih neh thingkong dongla na yalh tom vaengah lamhma la bok pai rhoi lamtah thangthui rhoi. Vaan kah BOEIPA te hloep lamtah nangming rhoi taengah rhennah neh sadingnah m'paek bitni. Mawnnah khueh boeh, diklai a saii hlan lamloh anih te nang ham ni a hmoel coeng.  Tobias loh Raphael ol te a yaak vaengah anih te a cako ni tila a ming. A napa kah rhuirhong neh khaw a pha uh dongah anih te bahoeng muep a lungnah tih a thinko boeih anih taengla a hong.
\s1 Raguel Im A Pha Rhoi

Ecbatana la a kun rhoi vaengah, Tobias loh anih te, “Manuca Azariah, mah manuca Raguel taengla thaeng n'caeh puei,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. Te dongah anih te Raguel im la a khuen. Amah loh amih rhoi te, “Ka hui Tobit te na ming rhoi a?” a ti nah.

\s1 Tobiah neh Sarah Yuva Rhoi

Namah yuu la lo laeh. Tahae lamkah tah a nganpa la na om coeng tih anih khaw na ngannu la om coeng. Anih te tihnin lamloh kumhal duela nang taengah kam paek coeng. Vaan kah BOEIPA loh ka ca nang n'hoihaeh saeh. Tihnin hlaem ah khaw nangmih rhoi te n'thaihtak sak saeh lamtah rhennah neh ngaimongnah nangmih rhoi m'pae saeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te vaengah, “Moses cabu dongkah a daek olkhueng neh oltloeknah bangla anih he namah yuu la lo laeh. Anih te lo lamtah na pa taengah sading la pha puei. Vaan kah Pathen loh amah kah ngaimongnah rhangneh nan longpuei han khui sak saeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Ka hinghlu aw, boeilen manghai, Boeipa te uem lah,

Jerusalem tah kumhal kah a im bangla a thoh pawn ni Ka tiingan lamkah a meet ca khaw sueng mai koinih bahoeng ka omngaih sue, Na thangpomnah neh vaan manghai mingnah te a hmuh lah mako  
\m Jerusalem vongka te minhum neh lungsen neh a sak ni. Na vongtung boeih te tah lungto lungvang neh a sak ni, Jerusalem rhaltoeng im te sui neh a sak vetih A rhalmah im te sui cilh neh a sak ni. Jerusalem longpuei te khaw tamkuei neh Ophri lungto a phaih ni

Jerusalem vongka rhoek loh omngaihnah Laa a sak vetih, Im boeih long khaw ‘Hallelukah’ neh tamhoe uh ni  
\m Israel kah Pathen tah a yoethen pai saeh A ming cim khaw kumhal ah kumhal duela a yeothen pai saeh.
\s1 Tobit kah Cilsuep Hnukkhueng
Te tlam te Tobit kah koehnah ol tah bawt

Tobit kum ya kum kul a lo vaengah duek tih a lenkoek hinyahnah neh Nineveh a om uh. Anih he sawmrhuk kum nit a loh a mik tueng pawh. Te phoeiah khaw koep then tih ngaikhuek la hing. Doedannah dongah Pathen kah yoethennah kha a puh pah. Te vaengah Pathen kah rhuepomnah khaw a ming.
A duem tom vaengah tah a capa Tobias neh Tobias ca rhoek parhi te a khue tih hekah ol he a paek. “Ka capa aw na ca rhoek te hang khuen paeh.

Media la tlek yong laeh. Nineveh kawng ah Nahum loh Pathen ol a thui te ka tangnah. Te ol boeih te tah Assyria neh Nineveh soah thoeng pawn ni. Te Israel tonghma rhoek loh a thui ngawn coeng. Amih te Pathen loh a tueih dongah thoeng pawn ni. Ol boeih he aka hloo om mahpawh. Amah a tue a pha vaengah oltak la thoeng ni. Te dongah Assyria neh Babylon lakah khaw Media ah a dingsuek eh. Pathen loh a thui te tah soep vetih oltak la thoeng ni tila ka tangnah. Tonghma ol he tah pakhat khaw hloo mahpawh. Ma cako boeih Israel khohmuen ka khosa boeih khaw, a thaek vetih khohmuen then lamloh tamna la a khuen ni. Israel khohmuen boeih te khopong la om ni. Samaria neh Jerusalem khaw khopong la om ni. Pathen bawkim khaw amah diklai ah a hoeh uh vetih mikhap tok ah khopong la poeh ni.

Tedae Pathen loh amih soah haidamnah a khueh ni. Te vaengah Pathe amih te Israel khohmuen la a mael puei vetih Pathen bawkim koep a sak uh ni. A tue soepnah a pha hlan hil tah lamhma kah pakhat bangla om mahpawh. Te phoeiah tah vangawn lamloh mael uh vetih Jerusalem rhuepom la a sak uh eh. Israel tonghma rhoek loh a thui bangla te vaengah Pathen bawkim khaw a sak uh ni.
Namtom boeih khaw thovael uh vetih oltak dongah Pathen a bawk uh ni. Amih khohmang la aka mawt a mueirhol te khaw a hnawt uh ni.

Duengnah dongah dungyan Pathen te a koeh uh pawn ni. Te khohnin ah tah Israel ca boeih daem uh pawn ni. Oltak ah Pathen poeknah neh tun tingtun uh ni. Amih te Jerusalem la ce tih uh vetih Abraham khohmuen ah kumhal due sading la kho a sak uh ni. Te te amih taengah ni a paek eh. Lunghoeih la Pathen aka lungnah rhoek a kohoe ni. Tedae tholhnah neh halangnah aka sai boeih tah diklai lamloh milh ni.

Te dongah ka capa nang kang uen coeng. Pathen taengah uepom la thothueng lamtah a mikhmuh a thuem mah saii. Na ca rhoek khaw a thuem saii ham neh doendannah khueh ham te uen. A tue boeih dongah khaw a poeknah neh a thadueng ah khaw Pathen kah lungbuei te khueh saeh lamtah a ming te uem saeh.
Te dongah ka capa aw Nineveh lamloh nong laeh, heah he om boeh.

Kai taengah na nu rhok na up nen tah khopuei pingpang ah he hlaem pakhat pataeng rhaeh boeh. A khui metla a halang uh khaw ka hmuh coeng. A khui ah laithae muep a saii uh. Te vaengah pilnam he a yah a khueh moenih.  
 Ka capa aw, Nadab loh A hikat te a lungnah tih a taengah a saii lah ko. Anih om voel pawt dae hing pueng, diklai khuila a suntlak puei ta nama? He bang yahkoi kho boeng dongah ni Pathen loh anih te a thuung. Ahikat te khosae la koep a mael vaengah Nadab tah dunyan khohmuep khui lamni a suntlak. Anih loh Ahikar te ngawn hamla a taeng. Tedae Ahikat tah hlang doedannah a khueh dongah, anih ham Nadab a tung pah dueknah hlaeh lamloh loeih. Tedae Nadab amah te cungku tih milh.

Te dogah ka ca aw, doedannah loh a hoeikhang sak te khaw, halangnah loh dueknah a om sak te khaw ming. Tedae kai tah ka hil awt coeng,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.  
\s1 Tobit neh Anna kah Dueknah  
 Te phoeiah anih te thingkong dongah a yalh sak uh tih duek. Te vaengah anih rhokom khaw hinyahkap la a dang.
Tobias manu a duek vaengah khaw ana pa taengah a up. Te phoeiah tah a yuu a ca neh Media la mael tihEcbatana kah a masae Raguel taengah kho a sak.
A mae sae rhoi khaw a patong hinyahnah neh a sawt. Amih rhoi te Media Ecbatanah a up. Anih loh Raguel kah khaw, a napa Tobit kah koe te khaw boeih a pang.
Tobias he kum ya neh kum hlai rhih a lo vaengah hinyanah a om tloe la duek.

A duek hlan ah mah Ninevah a cungku te a yaak coeng. Media la thongtla a khuen te khaw, Media mang Cyaxered loh tamta a khuen te khaw a hm uh. Nineveh neh Assyria pilnam soah a cungkuem a saii pah vanbangla Tobias loh Pathen te a koeh. A duek hlanah mah Nineveh te omngaih la a uem coeng. Boeipa Pathen te kumhal ah a uem yoeyah. Amen

headers.im: Judith cabu he lamhma cuek kah Hebrew ol la a tael dae Bible cungnueh (canon) dongah thum sak uh pawh a ti. AD 397 Carthage Council tunpuei neh, AD 1549 Trent tunpuei ah tah canon dongah a hlum uh. Judith dongah he Antiokus Epiphanes (175-164 BC) tue vaengkah khosaknah kawng tueng. Te vaengah he bang catael he muep muep om. He cabu long tah Palestine kah Jews rhoek taengah a rhal te oel ham neh Pathen olkhueng dongah uepom la om ham a a thaphoh. Rhainah meyet om mai cakhaw thincak thin-om lah Pathen olkhueng dongah pai ham te a thui.
