Aka cim koek aw, a cim boeih kah Boepa aw, ka ciim uh paek pueng ah, na im he kumhal a poeih pawt ham hoeptlang lah,” a ti uh.   
\s1 Khohmuen Ham Razis Duek

Te vaengah Jerusalem kah a hamca pakhat Razis Nicarnor taengah tholh a pael uh. He kah hlang he a pacaboeina a lung tah a poeknah khaw then, a boe khaw a then dongah Judah rhoek loh a napa la a khue uh.
Lamhma ah khaw nih he Gentile rhoek neh a pitpom uh moenih. Judah phung dongah khaw nah aih, Judah phung ham tah a pum neh a hingnah phum ham tlungmu tila a pael uh.
Nicanor long khaw Judah rhoek rhalcak la a khueh te tueng sak a ngaih coeng dongah anih te tuuk hamla rhalkap yanga hlai a tuuk.
Anih te a tuuk pa vaengah tah Judah rhoek salaem la om ni tila Nicanor loh a poek.
Imsang te a loh uh tom vaengah tah khokaep kah vongka te khaw a nen uh coeng. Thohkhaih te hoeh hamla hmai te khaw a loh sak. Koep a vael uh vaengah tah Razis te khaw amah cunghang dongah kaeh uh.
Rhal rhoek kut dongah cung tih hlangcong capa neh a tiing mueh la patang lakah tah, rhuepomnah neh duek te ni a ngaih ngai.

A thingthuel doela thun uh ngawn dae buelh thun uh thai pawh. Hlangping khaw thohka lamloh huk kung coeng. Te dongah rhalthennah la pangbueng soah yong tih, thinomnah neh amah te hlangping lakli la cungpung.
Tedae a hnuk la bang nong uh tih a hmuen te pung a hoeng dongah anih te hmuen hoeng kah a laklung tla.
Amih te hing pueng tih a thintoek khaw sai coeng. Koe a thoh hang vaengah tah a thii yawlyawl a coe pah. A hma hoeng la hlang ping te a muk phai tih lungpang kah a ngo dongah pai.

A thii khaw boeih a long vaengah tah a kotak te a poh coeng. A kut rhoi neh bok a poh tih hlang ping khuila a haeh. Te vaengah hingnah Boeipa te a khue tih a hingnah te amah taengla a paek. Hetah anih ka dueknah kawng ni.
Judas neh a lambong rhoek te Samaria pingpang ah om tila Nicanor loh a yaak vaengah a dingsuek la duemnah khohnin ah tloek hamla mangtaengah a khueh.

Anih aka vai Judah rhoek loh amah te a hloep uh tih, “Tlungal neh muenying muenyang lamtah phae aih boeh. Hno cungkuem aka hmuh loh a hinyahnah tih a tloe khohnin lakah a cim sak khohnin te tah hinyanah mai saw,” a ti na uh.
Rhaepthum la aka halang loh, “Sabbath hnin tuem hamla ol aka pae vaan Khohni khaw om tang nim,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Te dongah, “Boeipa amah hing tih vaan ah Khohni la om coeng, amah long kaimih he a hnin rhih dongah yaeh hamla ol m'paek coeng,” a ti nah hatah,

Kai khaw diklai ah khohni la ka om coeng, na pumcumnah te lo uh lamtah manghai kah bitat mah saii uh ka ti,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. Tedae a mangtaengnah tueilaeh koi te a thaihtak la a thoeng pa thai moenih.   
\s1 Makkabi tah Judah Rhoek Ham Rhuengphong
Nicanor tah a khuetnah hil ah oek uh tih, a thinlennah soah Judas neh a rhalkap rhoek a tanah lungpang te ling hamla cai.
Tedae Makkabi tah Boeipa lamkah bomnah om bitni tila ngaikhueknah neh a pangtung te a paa tlaih moenih.
Gentile rhoek kah a tloeknah te rhih boel lamtah, lamhma ah khaw vaan lamkah bomnah a pai te an lungbuei ah khueh uh, Tlungthang Boeipa loh amih soah tannah m'paek ham te so uh,” tila a thaphoh.
Amih te tonghma rhoek kah olkhueng nen khaw a thaphoh tih tanah dang ham a thingthuelnah te khaw amih a yaak sak dongah amih te thahluenah muep a paek.
Amih kah rhalthennah a huek phoeiah tah boesoepnah te a khueh. Te vaengah Gentile rhoek loh amamih kah olhlo a phaenah kawng te khaw a phoe pah.
Amih te photling neh cai lakah khaw rhalthennah ol dongkah thapaeknah nen ni a mih pumcumsak. A mangtuk mangthui neh, aka tueng tangnah loh amih te ko boeih a hoe sak.

He he Onias loh a hm uh. Anih he khosoih ham la, hlangcong neh hlang then la om coeng. A khuetnet la cal tih a camoe lamloh boethen neh phaep uh coeng. Anih loh Judah pum boeih hamla kut a phuel tih thang thui.
Te vaengah mah muei phek la a tloe pakhat phoe bal. Anih te a sampok neh, hinomnah neh thingcam uh. A rhuepomnah neh saithainah kho khobae rhambae la om.
Te vaengah Onias loh, “Hekah hlang tah Israel imkhui aka lungnah tih pilnam neh khopuei cim ham muep aka thangthui, Pathen tonghma Jeremiah ni,” a ti.
Jeremiah loh bantang kut koe a thueng tih Judas te sui cunghang koe a paek.
Te te a paek phoeiah tah, “Pathen taengkah kut doe, cunghang cim la lo, na thimkalh boeih khaw te nen ni na tloek eh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Judas kah ol loh a thaphoh uh dongah, bahoeng hapcawh uh tih thadueng khaw muep a huek pah. Cadong rhoek kah hinglu tah rhalthennah a haenghang pah. Te dongah rhaeh mailai ham pawt tih rhalthen la tloek ham a poek uh. Thinomnah boeih neh a kut, kut ah hnueih uh thae hamla ol a tloek uh. Khopuei rhokso neh a bawkim tah maeh la a mop uh coeng dongah.
Amih te a yuu a ca, ngannu nganca neh huiko kawng dongah hnorhih la a phueih moenih. Lamhma la rhoso a tim ham kawng dongah ni a mawn uh.

Khohoeng ah mawnnah a hmuh dongah khaw khopuei khuikah aka om rhoek kah ngaihmangnah he a yol mai moenih.   
\s1 Nicarnor kah Dueknah

A taengla aka lo ham te boeih a hmuh coeng. Rhal rhoek te khaw a kut dongah rhel om coeng, a rhalkap rhoek te khaw caemtloek neh yoei coeng. Namtlak ah vuei boeih a khueh tih, a vae ah marhang caem boeih a pai sak coeng.

A hmai ah khawk a om pah tih, rhalkap soeprhae, vuei tlung neh a om te Makkabi loh a hmuh vaengah tah vaan la a kut a phuel tih kopoekrhai hno aka saii Boeipa te a khueh. Anih long tah rhal tanah he rhalkap rhangnen moenih, Boeipa rhnang nen ni. Amah aka tingtawk tah tannah a paek ti khaw a ming.
Boeipa te he ol neh a khue tih, “Aw Boeipa, Judea manghai Hezekiah tue vaengah khaw na puencawn na tueih tih amah loh Sennakherib rhaehhmuen ah hlang thawng ya sawmrhet panga a ngawn ta.
Te dongah vaan kah Khohni aw puencawn then han tueih laeh. Kamih hmai kah he mueirhih neh thuennah taekyak lah.
Na hmuen cim rhup tulh ham soehsalnah neh aka lo rhoek khaw na ban tha loh ngawn saeh,” a ti. He ol neh a thangthuinah te a bawk sak.
Nicanor neh a lambong rhoek te olueng neh, caemtloek laa te khong uh.
Tedae Judas neh a lambong rhoek long caemtloek kah rhal te Pathen khuenah, thangthuinah nen ni a doe uh.
Te dongah a kut neh a hnueih vaengah a thinko tah Boeipa taengah thui. Te vaengah hlang thawng sawmthum thawng nga tluk a cungku sak. Te dongah Pathen a pumphoenah rhangneh a kohoe uh.
A tatvuetnah a poeng phoeiah omngaih mael uh. Te vaengah Nicanor neh pumcumnah cungkuem neh a rhok la a yalh te a hmat uh.
Te vaengah tah yuhui uh tih he uh. A napa rhoek kah olka neh Khohni Boeipa te a uem uh.

Pum neh hinglu te a pilnam kah tungaepnah aka hmoel yoeyah hlang, a camoe lamloh a pacaboeina taengah boethen aka khueh hlang loh Nicanor kah a lu neh a ban te rhaih tih Jerusalem la khuen ham ol a paek.
Jerusalem a pha vaengah tah a pacaboeina te tun a khue tih khosoih rhoek te hmueihtuk hmaiah a pai te. Te vaengah rhalmah im aka om rhoek te khaw a tah.
Te phoeiah a koevoeinah te Tlungthang im cim la kut aka thueng hlang rhong Nicanor kah a lu neh a ban te amih taengah a tueng.
Pathen aka mingmueh Nicanor ka a lai te khaw a tloek tih, vaa taengah aipueng la vuelh ham a hoei pah. He tah rhokoso taeng a ang a sop phu coeng.
Te vaengah vaan la boeih oeloe uh tih amah aka phoe Boeipa te a uem uh. “Amah kah hmuen cim poeihlak pawt ham aka khoem Boeipa tah a yoethen pai,” a ti uh.
Nicanor kah a lu te rhalmah im a tai pah tih Boeipa kah bomnah kawng te hlang boeih ham miknoek ni tila a cimphan la a tueng sak.

Rhangpuei loh oltloeknah a khueh uh tih te khohnin te dalh uh tlaih pawh. Te tah Aramaih loh Adar hla om tih Mordecai hnin hlanah te a khueh uh.   
\s1 Taikhaihnah Ol
He tah Nicanor taeng lamloh hno aka thoeng te pawn ni. He lamlong tah khopuei te Hebrew rhoek kah khohut la om coeng. Te dongah ka cil he ka bawt sak.
A then la thui tih thuinuet ham ni kamah long ka ngaihnah a om. Then pawt tih vawt cakhaw ka sai thai khuiah ni ka saii van ngawn.

Yu amah bueng ok he rhih hamla om, tui tangsoeng ok khaw rhih hamla om bal. Tui neh yu neh thoek vaengah tah didip tih hlihlim, hlang khaw a omngaih sak. Te vangbangla he cil kah a then khaw a bibi kawng aka tae rhoek kah a hna ah tah ngaingaih koi la coeng. He nen he bawt mai pawn saeh.

headers.im: Vangsawn lamkah a mael uh tih Judea kah Jews rhoek koep a thoh vaengah Esdras loh cabu pali a tael. Anih kah cabu a pacuek neh a pabae Ezra neh Nehemiah he Protestant long khaw, Roman Catholic long khaw, Jews rhoek long khaw boeih a pom. Esdras cabu rhoi he tah Jew rhoek kah Hebrew Bible dongah khaw, Protestant Bible dongah khaw thum pawh. Jerome kah a kong Latin Vulgate Bible (AD 404) dongah tah Esdras 1 (Ezra), Esdras 2 (Nehemiah), Esdras 3 la a khueh.

verses.text:
\s1 Josiah loh Yoom A Caak  
\r (2Mg 23. 21-23; 2Kh 35. 1-9)
Boeipa thangpomnah hamla Josiah loh Jerusalem ah Yoom a saii. Hla khat hnin hlai li vaengah tah khotue maeh te a ngawn uh.
Josiah loh khosoih rhoek te a coi tih hnin takuem Bawkim khuiah aitlaeng la thothueng ham, a himbai neh a thoeih cam.
Levi rhoek khaw, bawkim tueihyoeih rhoek khaw Boeipa bibi dongah amamih a cilpoe tih, David capa Solomon la a sak Boeipa Bawkim kah Paipi thingkawng cim te koh hamla ol a paek.

Josiah loh amih te hmuen khat lamloh hmuen khat la kawt uh voel boeh. Nangmih na Pathen Boeipa taengah tho aka thueng tih, a pilnam Israel kah bibi la na om uh. Imkhui neh koca loh na bibi te saii hamla sikim uh laeh.
Manghai David kah olpaek bangla a capa manghai Solomon long khaw a rhuepom la a saii. Israel pilnam ham Levi loh Boeipa bi a bi bangla na cako kah a hutnah te a thuem la bawkim ah a hmuen lo uh.
Yoom kah tuca neh mae te khaw ngawn uh lamtah na hui Israel ca ham hmueih te tawn uh. Te phoeiah Yoom te Boeipa loh Moses taengah uentonah a paek bangla saii uh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Josiah loh pilnam aka thum rhoek taengah tu thawng sawmthum, maae ca thawng thum a paek. He tah pilnam teangah, khosoih taengah, Levi rhoek taengah ol a khueh bangla manghai im lamkah ni kutdoe la a paek.
Te vaengah bawkim aka hutnah boei rhoek tah, Hikiah, Zekhariah neh Heiel tih. Amih he khosoih la om tih tu thawng hnih yarhuk neh khotue kah hmueih la vaito ca yathum a paek.
Rhalboei rhoek la Conaniah, Shemaiah neh a mana Nethel, Hashabiah Cohiel neh Joram long khaw Levi rhoek kah hmueih a nawn ham tu thawng nga neh vaitoca yarhih te a paek.

Te vaengah amah he tlam he om van. Khosoih neh Levi rhoek loh amah a rhoep la phuekhlak uh tih vaidamding te a khuen uh. Mincang a pha vaengah tah Moses olkhueng kah a uen bangla Boeipa taengah nawnnah te a paek uh.
Amah imkhui neh koca kah boelnah bangla pilnam hmaiah a buhham te a khuen uh.
Levi rhoek loh Yoom hmuen te a hai uh tih am dongah a thong uh phoeiah baeldung dongah a bo a tui la a khueh uh.
Te phoeiah tah maeh te pilnam boeih hamla a tael pa uh. Te tlam te boeih a saii uh phoeiah tah maeh te amamih ham he Aaron cadil khosoih rhoek ham te a loh uh.
Khosoih rhoek he hlaem a pha hil hmueih kah a tha a phum tih mat tok uh.

Asaph koca Levi rhoek khuikah bawkim vongka aka tawt rhoek neh laasa rhoek tah manghai David kah uentonah bangla amah kah a hmuen ah om uh. Asaph, Zekhariah neh Eddinus amih he tah manghai yueng la om uh coeng.
Amih ham tah a tloe rhoek loh Yoom he a soepboe pah coeng dongah a paihmuen te nongtak ham ngoe pawh.
Manghai Josiahkah olpaek bangla Boeipa taengah nawn ham hmueih neh aka tukkai boeih te tah tekah khohnin ah a saii uh.
Yoom khotue khaw a bul uh tih hmueih te khaw hmueihtuk dongah a nawn uh.
Israel pilnam boeih tah Yoom tue vaengah thum uh tih vaidamding khotue te kha hnin rhih khuiah a yaeh uh.
Tonghma Samuel tue lamkah te Yoom he uepom la a saii uh moenih.
Lamhma kah Israel manghai rhoek khuiah khaw he tlam he Yoom aka saii pakhat khaw a om moenih.

He tah manghai Josiah loh a manghai nah kum hlai rhet vaengah Jerusalem aha s aii tih khosoih rhoek, Levi rhoek khaw, Judah neh Israel pilnam boeih long khaw a bul puei.   
\s1 Josiah Manghai A Bawtnah
Bawknah dongah a dung la a om dongah, Josiah kah a saii boeih te Boeipa loh a uem pah.

Tedae yankah cabu long khaw a cil te a thui. Josiah a manghai vaengah Boeipa taengah aka tholh tih boekoek rhoek khaw om a tih. Amih te a tloe namtu neh ram lakah khaw tholh uh tih Boeipa tloelnah hno te a saii uh. Te dongah a laitloeknah te Israel pilnam soh khung a tlak pah.
He tlam he Josiah loh boeih a saii phoeiah tah, Egypt manghai loh Perath tuiva kah Carchemis ah tloek uh rhoi ham caem a khuen.
Anih te Josiah loh a paa sak ngawn dae Egypt manghai loh Josiah taengla ol a pat tih, “Judah manghai te caem la kan tloek mahpawh.

Boeipa Pathen nang tloek hamla n'tueih moenih. Ka caemtloeknah he tah Perath ah ni a om. Kai taengah Boeipa om, Boeipa loh kah n'cahawh coeng. Te dongah na lambong te bal puei laeh, Boeipa te oel boeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Tedae Josiah loh a hnuk mael pawt tih, a leng te khaw balkhong sak pawh. Tonghma Jeremaih dong lamloh Boeipa kah a thui te hnatun ham a aal tih, tloek hamla ko a tam.
Megiddo kol ah caemtloek la cet van dae Egypt rhalboei rhoek loh amah te a tloek uh.
Manghai Josiah loh a sal rhoek te, “Caemtloek hmuen lamloh n'khuen uh laeh, rhaidaeng la ka hmalaem coeng,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. Te dongah anih te caemtloek kah rhongpai lamloh vik a khueh uh.
Anih te leng a tloe a loh pa uh tih Jerusalem la a mael puei uh. Teah a duek dongah anih te boei kah phuel ah a up uh.

Judah pilnam boeih tah anih hamla nguekcoi uh.  
 Tonghma Jeremiah loh manghai Josiah te rhaengsaelung neh a rhaeng sae. Te te Israel khuiah khaw khosing la om coeng. A lu rhoek neh a yuu rhoek long khaw anih ham a nguekcoi uh vaengah hekah laa he a sak uh.

Hekah olka he Judah manghai rhoek kah khokhuen dongah a khueh. Josiah loh a saii boeih, a mingthen a dang khaw, olkhueng a yakimingnah khaw, lamhma kah a saii boeih khaw Israel neh Judah minghai rhoek kah khokhuen dongah a khoem.   
\b  
\s1 Judah manghai Joahaz
Judah rhoek loh Josiah capa Joahaz te a tuek uh tih a manghai la a khueh uh vaengah Joahaz tah kum kul kum thum lo coeng.
Anih loh Judah neh Jerusalem te a uk ngawn dae Egypt manghai loh anih te vik a khoe.
Te phoeiah cak talen yakhat, sui talen khat te mangmu la a thoh sak.
Egypt manghai loh Joahaz mana Joakim te Judea neh Jerusalem kah manghai la a khueh.

Te vaengah Joakim te boei la a pin dae a mana Zarakes loh a muk tih Egypt khui lamkah vawl a caeh puei.   
\s1 Judah manghai Joakim
Joakim he kum kul kum nga a lo ca vaengah Judae neh Jeruslaem a manghai tih Boeipa kah mikhmuh ah a thae ni a saii.
Te vaengah anih Babylon manghai Nabuchodonosor loh anih te a paan tih rhohum rhui neh a khih phoeiah Babylon la a khuen.
Nabuchodonosor loh Boeipa kah hnopai te a loh tih a phueih phoeiah amah Babylon bawkim ah a khueh.

Tedae anih kah olthang khaw, a cim pawt neh a rhong khaw manghai rhoek kah khokhuencil dongah a kun sak.   
\b  
\s1 Judah manghai Jehoiakhin
Joakim yueng la a capa koep manghai tih, anih te manghai la a khueh uh vaengah kum hlairhet ni a lo ca pueng.
Anih te Jerusalem ah hla thum neh hnin rha manghai dae Boeipa mikhmuh ah boethae ni a saii.
Kum khat phoeiah tah nah Nabuchodonosor loh hlang tueih tih anih neh Boeipa kah honpai cim te Babylon la a loh sak.

Te phoeiah Sedekias te Judae neh Jerusalem kah manghai la a khueh. Te vaengah anih te kum kul kum khat lo ca pueng tih kum hlai khat tah manghai van.   
\s1 Judah manghai Zedekiah Jerusalem A Rhawpnah
Anih he khaw Boeipa mikhmuh ah a thae ni a saii. Jeremy dong lamloh Boeipa ol aka thoeng te khaw a ngaithuen moenih.

Boeipa ming neh Nabuchodonosor loh anih te a toemngam thil lamlong tah amah neh amah ta-aep nah coeng tih boe a koek coeng. A rhawn neh a thin a thah sak tih Israel Pathen Boeipa kah olkhueng te boeih a aek.
Pilnam kah khoboei rhoek neh khosoih rhoek loh boethae muep a saii uh.
A napa rhoek kah Pathen loh amih te hnuk mael khue ham a puencawn a tueih. Boeipa long tah amah omnah hmuen dongah thinphoei lungvatnah a khueh.
Boeipa loh amih a voek hnin ah khaw puencawn rhoek te a lawn uh tih tonghma te khaw a ho uh.
A pilnam te a thae rhoekoe caih coeng dongah amih neh a tingtawk la amih taengah Khalden manghai rhoek te a tueih pah.
Te long te cadong rhoek a bawkim cim kaepvai ah tumca neh a rhaih pah. Ca dong hula khaw tloe pawh, patong camoe khaw tloe pawh, Khalden rhoek kah kut dongah boeih a voeih.
Boeipa kah hopai cim boeih tah a yol a len khaw, Boeipa thingkawng dongkah hnopai khaw, manghai kah khohrhang khaw Babylon ka bat a khueh.
Boeipa im te khaw a hlup uh tih Jerusalem vongtung khaw a tulh uh phoeiah, a imsang khaw hmai neh a hoeh pa uh.
Thangpomnah hnopai boeih te a boeih hil a hmai mueh la a khueh uh. Pilnam tah tumca neh ngawn mueh la Babylon la a khuen.
Persian kah uknah tue a pha hil a ca rhoek khaw a taengah sal la om uh tih Jeremiah ka dong lamloh aka thoeng Boeipa ol te soep.
Khohmuen loh a Sabbath a uem hlan hil, kum sawmrhih khuiah tah Sabbath a tuem ham khaw a tue boeih tal uh.
Persia manghai Cyrus kah a kum khat nah dongah tah Jeremiah ka dong lamkah Boeipa ol aka thoeng te soep.
Boeipa loh Persia manghai Cyrus kah mueihla te a cahoeh pah. Te dongah a ram tom ah olhoenah a khueh tih a daek pah.
Persian manghai Cyrus tah Isarael kah Boeipa, Khohni Boeipa loh diklai pum kah manghai la kai n'khueh coeng.
Judaea kah Jerusalem kah im pakhat sak hamla ol m'paek coeng.

Pakhat khaw a pilnam la aka om boeih tah Boeipa te a Boeipai la om saeh lamtah a taengah om puei saeh. Anih te Judaea kah Jerusalem la caeh sak saeh lamtah Israel Boeipa kah im te sa saeh. Amah tah Jerusalem ah aka om Boeipa pai ni.
Te dongah Khotom rhali kah aka om boeih long khaw, amah kho ham tah sui neh, cak neh rhip bom uh saeh.
Kutdoe nen khaw, marhang nen khaw, saelhung neh khaw, te phoeiah Jerusalem kah Boeipa im ham olhlo nen khaw ka thap coeng lah ko,” a ti.

Te vaengah Judah imkhui neh Benjamin koca kah a lu khaw pai uh coeng. khosoih rhoek khaw, Levi rhoek khaw, Jerusalem kah Boeipa im aka sa la caeh ham te, Boeipa loh amih kah mueihla boeih a cahoeh pah coeng.

Te dongah a kaepvai kah khosak rhoek loh amih te a cungkuem la, cak neh, sui neh, marhang neh, saelhung neh a bom uh. A lungbuei a cahoeh pah rhoek hlangmi khaw a yet dongah a olhlo bangla kutdoe khaw muep yet.
Manghai Cyrus long khaw Boeipa im kah umam koep a thak. Te tah Nabuchodonosor loh Jerusalem kah loh tih mueirhol bawkim ah vik a khueh te ni.
Te vaengah Persian manghai Cyrus loh te rhoek te a loh tih tangka khoem Methradate kut a paek.
Anih long khaw Judaea khoboei Sanabassar kut ah a paek.
Te rhoek boeih te a pum la sui boengloeng thawng khat, cakben boengloeng thawng khat, cak tha om pakul pako, sui bunang sawmthum, cak te thawng hnih yali parha neh a tloe baelyak te thawngkhat lo.
Te dongah sui neh ca a khuen boeih te thawng nga yali sawm rhuk pako lo.

Te tah Sanabassar loh tamna rhoek neh Babylon lamloh Jerusalem la a mael puei.   
\s1 Jerusalem Thoh Ham Vaengah Tloelhnah

Persian manghai Artaxerxes tue vaengah Belemus, Mithradates, Tablelius, Rathumus, Beeltethum long khaw, cadaekung Samellius neh amih te a bong uh tih Samaria neh a tloe hmuen kah khosa rhoek loh Judaea neh Jurusalem kah kawng te a dangkah bangla ca a pat uh.
Cil aka khoem Rathumus khaw, cadaekung Samellius khaw, a tloe khoboei rhoek khaw, Coelesyria neh Phoenicia kah laitloekung rhoek khaw na sal boeih ni.

Ka boei manghai taengah khaw mingphanah om pawn saeh. Nang taeng lamloh kaimih taengla aka lo Judah rhoek tah Jerusalem la ha pai uh coeng. Boekoek neh halang tih khopuei thoh ham a saii uh. Hnoyoih hmuen neh vongtung khaw a tlaih uh tih, bawkim kah khoengim khaw a up coeng.
Khopuei te a thoh uh tih vong te khaw a khah uh coeng. Mangmu paek ham a aal uh vetih manghai tloelh ham pai uh pawn ni.
Te phoeiah he bang hno he bawkim khuila kun tih a kut dongah om uh coeng. He bang he sawtsut ham moenih tila ka poek uh.
Te ka manghai boeipa taengah thui ham neh, na ngai ham khaw tueng. Na huem bal atah na pa rhoek kah cabu dongah khaw so nawn.
Khokhuencil dongah hekah olka adaek te khaw so nawn. He khopuei he boe a koek uh dongah manghai neh khopuei rhoek a patang sak te khaw ming nawn.
Judah rhoek he boekoek rhoek ni, a rhuem tue vaengah khaw rhal la thoo uh. Te dongah ni khopuei khaw imrhong la a yalh sak.

Te dongah ni ka boei manghai taengah kan yaak sak. Khopuei te thoh tih vong te a thai la tung koini, tahae lamkah long tah Coelesyria neh Phoenica la pawnhlainah om voel mahpawh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Te dongah manghai loh Cil aka khoem Rathumus khaw, cadaekung Samellius khaw, a tloe khoboei rhoek khaw, Coelesyria neh Phoenicia kah laitloekung rhoek khaw a dangkah bangla ca koep a pat.
Kai ham ca nan pat uh te ka tae ngawn coeng. Te dongah khenah khueh hamla ol ka paek coeng. Te vaengah, khopuei he a rhuem ah khaw manghai taengah boekoeknah a khueh te a hm uh.
Boekoek neh rhal la a thoh uh dongah Coelesyria neh Phoenicia aka uk tih mangmu aka lo manghai hlang tlung rhoek loh Jerusalem ah thinsanah a khueh uh.
Te dongah ol ka paek coeng lah ko. Khopuei aka sa hlang rhoek te khaw khoep mah uh tih. He ol neh kingkalh pakhat khaw saii pawt ham ngaithuen saeh.
Tebang halang bii aka saii rhoek loh manghai te ngae-lawn boel saeh,” a ti.

Manghai Artaxerxes kah a capat te a tae van neh, Rathumus, cadaek Samellius, a mih taengkah a rhoi boeih te a marhang neh, pilnam hlangping neh Jerusalem la koeloe thoeih uh tih, imsa rhoek te paa sak ham caemtloekneh rhong a pai. Te dongah Jerusalem bawkim kah a sak uh te khaw Persian manghai Darius kah a manghainah a kumbae hil paa uh.   
\b
Manghai Darius loh a sal boeih ha, a im kah a cun boeih ham neh Media Persia kah mangpa boeih hamla khotue kueng a saii pah.
Te vaengah boeilu khaw, rhalboei khaw, a hmui kah khoboei khaw, India lamloh Ethiopia hil ram ya pakul parhih lo uh.
A caak, a ok uh tih a hah uh phoeiah tah im la mael uh. Manghai Darius khaw a imkhan la cet tih ip dae a ih kung lamloh haenghang.
Te vaengah kanghai aka tawt pum-oep hlang cadong pathum te khat neh khat voek uh thae.
Mamih kah ming he pae sih lamtah diklai hmankah aka khuet koek ming la khueh sih. He oldawtnah he a cui la a hlat tah kutdoe a len koek pae saeh lamtah tanah te khaw dang saeh.

Boeimang himbai te bai saeh lam tah sui boengloeng dongah o saeh. Sui thingkong dongah yalh saeh. A leng te khaw sui ngoldoelh kamrhui la om saeh. Hnitang lupong te khaw muei saeh lamtah, a sui oi te oi saeh.
A cueih van bangla anih te manghai kah baerhoep la om saeh. Manghai kah paya tila thangpomnah mingthen kaw pae saeh,” a ti uh.
Te dongah a poek thai khuila hlatnah a then te a daek uh tih manghai kah luhoe hmuiah a khueh. Te vaengah khat neh khat te,
“Manghai a haenghang vaengah tah ol he a taengah pae saeh. Amah neh Persia kah boei rhoek loh a cueih koek la hlatnah te pae saeh. A ta long tah a cadaek soah kutdoe te pae saeh,” a ti uh.
Lamhma loh, “Yu lakah tha aka om he om pawh,” tila a daek.
A pabae loh, “Manghai lakah tha aka om he om pawh,” a ti bal.
A pathum loh, “Huta lakah tha aka om he om pawh, tedae oltak long tah mebang khaw a ta,” tila a daek.
Manghai a haenghang vaengah tah ol a daek uh te a taengla a paek tih a tae.
Te dongah puencawn a tueih tih Persia neh Media kah boeilu rhoek khaw, boeiham rhoek khaw, taemkung khaw, khoboei khaw, caeltueih rhoek khaw tun a khue.
Oltunnah hmuen kah ngolhmuen a loh phoeiah tah ol pathum te tha-ue la a tae.
“Cadong pathum te hang khuen lamtah a hlatnah te thuicaih uh saeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*. Te dongah a taengla a khuen pa uh van.
Me bang a daek uh te khaw a thuicaih uh.
Yu kawng aka daek cadong long te lamhma la a thui tih, “Hinyah kap rhoek, yu he diklai hman ah tha aka om koek tihe phaeng m'ming coeng. Te aka om boeih tah a lungbuei boeih a hmaang sak coeng.
Hlang boeih soah khaw, manghai neh cadah soah khaw, sal neh sayalh taengah khaw, boei neh khodaeng soah khaw vanat lam ni a om.
Hlang boeih a omngaih sak tih a yalpo sak, kothae neh a bitat khaw a hnilh sak,
hlang boeih boei bangla a ngai sak tih manghai neh mangpa kah saithainah khaw a hnoelrho sak. Diklai pum he khaw amah kah bangla boeih a thui sak.
Yu o hlang rhoek loh a paya neh imben khaw a hmaai sak. Te dongah cunghang a yueh uh tih ngawn uh thae.
A caih uh vaengah tah mebang a saii uh khaw ming uh voel pawh.
Hinyah kap rhoek aw, yu loh he tlam a saii coeng atah, yu he diklai hmanah tha aka om koek rhep coeng ni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Manghai kah thaomnah aka daek long khaw koe thui van tih,
“Hinyah kap rhoek aw, hlang lakah tha aka om koek he diklai hmanah a om moenih. Hlang long he diklai neh tuitunli sokah aka om boeih khaw, diklai hman ka a cungkuem soah khaw a uktaem ta.
Tedae te rhoek boeih lakah khaw manghai he a tha-om koek. Manghai tah amih kah boeipa neh a kungmah la om. Hlang loh anih ol a ngai pah, mebang ol a thui mai a khaw.
Amih te caemtloeknah saii ti nah koinih a saii uh mai. Amih te caemrhal taengla tueih cakhaw cet uh mai coeng. Tlang khaw, pangbueng, imsang khaw phil a ti nah ca khaw, a saii uh mai.

Amih te ngawn ti mai cakhaw a ngawn mai coeng. Manghai kah olpaek aka aal he a om moenih. Tanah a dang uh vaengah khaw a kutbuem boeih te manghai ham a khuen pah. Caemtloek vaengah a dang boeih te khaw a khaw a khueh pah.
Lotawn khaw caemtloek la a caeh pawt atah, a cangah boeih te manghai taengla a thak coeng. Pakhat loh a hui khaw manghai taengah mangmu paek hamla a tanolh coeng.
Manghai amah bueng he hlang la a om coeng. Pilnam te ngawn saeh a ti atah a ngawn uh mai. Thongtla rhoek te loeih saeh a ti atah a loeih sak uh mai.
Amih te tloek saeh a ti atah a tloek uh mai. Amih te phae saeh a ti atah a phae uh mai. Im sa a ti atah a sak u mai hoeh.
Khohmuen cangvuei te phae ham neh phung ham a thui akhaw a rhoi uh mai.
Hlang boeih, rhalkap long khaw, rhaengpuei long khaw manghai ol te a ngai uh. Anih te caak ham ok ham a ngol vaengah khaw, a ih thuk ah khaw.
A taengom rhoek loh a taeng rhawp a tawt, anih ol te a ngaih pawt tah, hlang loh amah ngaih la cet tih amah bi te a bi thai moenih.

Hinyah kap rhoek aw, he tlam ni pilnam loh manghai ol a ngai. Te dongah anih lakah tha aka om he diklai ah om pawh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.   
\s2 Huta Kawng Thuinah
Te phoeiah a pathumnah ah, huta neh oltak kawng aka thui he, Jerubbable ni.
Anih long he atong tih, “Hinyah kap rhoek, manghai he a leng moenih, hlang khaw a yet moenih, yuu khaw a tha a om moenih. A soah uh lae aka om pueng, ulong te te a uk? Te tah huta moenih a?
Lan neh tuitunli soah aka boei manghai neh pilnam boeih he huta long ni a sak.
Amih te huta dong lamkah a thoeng. Yu la than ham misur kung aka tue hlang boeih khaw huta long ni a cun.
Huta loh hang ham himbai a tah, hlang thangpomnah khaw a saii, huta a om pawt atah hlang khaw a om thai moenih.
Tongpa long sui khaw, cak khaw, hnothen khaw a kol mai khaming. Suisak a hlang aka huta te a hmuh vaengah tah, tekah hno khaw boeih khum van.
A taengah longhoi om tih a taengah a ka a ang. Te dongah sui khaw, cak khaw, a tloe hnothen boeih khaw anih ham ni a om coeng.
Tongpa loh amah anih aka cun ana pa khaw, a khohmuen khaw a toeng tih a yuu taengla kap mai hoeh.
A khohnin khaw a yuu taengah a thok sak tih, a napa khaw, a manu khaw, a khohmuen khaw a poeknah om voel pawh.

Te dongah huta loh nang soah boei a bi te poek.  
 Patang neh na thakthae dae a cungkuem he huta taengla na paek moenih a?
Tongpa loh cunghang a loh tih yin la cet. Te vaengah a hue neh, a can neh tuipuei tuiva boeih a lan.
Sathueng neh hum uh tih, a hmuep ah khaw cet, a huen neh, a can neh, kutbuem la a khuen te a lungnah a yuu taeng lam ni a mael.
Hlang long he a manu a napa lakah khaw a yuu ni a lungnah ngai coeng.
Hlang a yet ngai he a yung kongah a kopoek mawth tih, a yuu kah sal lam khaw om uh.
Huta dongah ah muep poci uh tih, tongtah uh tih tholh uh.

Te dongah kai nan tangnahuh a?  
 Manghai khaw a saithainah neh a len tarha mai moenih? Diklai loh anih ben ham khaw boeih a rhih moenih?
Kai ngawn tah manghai kah yuthawn Apame khaw ka hmuh coeng. Anih mueirhoi Bartacus canu la om tih manghai kah bantang ah ngol.
Te vaengah manghai lu dongkah rhuisam te a dul tih amah loh a khuem. Te phoeiah a banvoei kut neh manghai te a bael bal pueng.
Manghai long khaw a ka a ang tih sut a sawt mai. Huta te cuep a nueih a tah anih khaw nuei van. Huta loh thintoek hoel a hlah vaengah, anih khaw hlampan van. Te daengah nih rhoeknah khaw a om pai eh.
Hinyah kap rhoek aw, te tlam te a saiithai dongah huta he a tha a om koek moenih a?

Te vaengah manghai neh hlangcong rhoek khaw khat neh khat so uh thae.  
\s2 Oltak Kawng A Thui  
 Te vaengah oltak kawng te koep a thui.
Hinyah kap rhoek, huta he a tha-om koek pawt nim? Diklai khaw ka, vaan khaw sang, khomik khaw a caelong ah thui mai. Vaan ah a hilnah khaw tih hin at amah hmuen koep a pha.
Te dongah he tluk la aka len he u long a saii? Tedae oltak he len tih hno boeih lakah ah khaw a tha-om.
Diklai pum loh oltak te ni a khue uh tih vaan long khaw oltak ni a uem. Pathen kah bibi boeih tah lingluei neh thuennah khaw, a songrhai he a om moenih.

Yu khaw songrhai, huta khaw songrhai, hlang hing boeih khaw songrhai ta. Manghai khaw songrhai ta. Amih kah bibi khaw songrhai ta, tekah boeih te tah. A khuiah oltak te a om pawt atah amih a songrhai lamni a poci uh eh.
Tedae oltak tah kuei tih thaomnah om yoeyah. Hing tih a yoeyah la a khulae thai yoeyah.
Oltak longtah hlaangnah neh maelhmai sawtnah khaw a khueh moenih. Songrhainah neh halangnah a om khaw duengnah ni a thui. Hlang boeih loh te nen ni a khoboe a ming thai.

A laitloeknah dongah khaw a songrhainah a om moenih. A kumhal duela tha-omnah khaw, manghainah, tha-omnah neh, rhuepomnah khaw a khueh. Oltak Pathen tah a yoethen rhoe pai,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Olthui bawt a khaw vaengah tah pilnam boeih te yuhui uh tih, “Oltak tah len tih a cungkuem lakah a tha-om koek,” a ti uh.   
\s1 Zerubbable Uemnah

Te vaengah manghai loh anih te, “Na ngaih te hoe lah, ca dongkah a voel ah khaw, nang te kan paek bitni, nang tah aka cueih koek la kan hmuh coeng. Kamah hnukthoi la na om coeng tih kamah huiko kan kang khue coeng,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Te dongah manghai te, “Manghai la na om vaengkah na olhlo te poek mai. Jerusalem thoh ham khaw,
Jerusalem lamkah na khuen hnopai boeih mael ham khaw, te Cyrus loh Babylon phae hamla a tong vaengah ni a rhoe coeng. Te te amah la mael ham na thui te.
Edom loh Judea a phae tih Chalden loh a rhok la a yalh sak Bawkim khaw koep sak ham na kam coeng.

Manghai boei aw, he ni nang taengah kan bih tih kan dawt. He ni na lennah phu lamkhaw a om eh. Te dongah vaan kah manghai taengah namah hmuilai neh a hlo te mah a soepnah hamla olhlo te soep sak mai,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te vaengah manghai Darius te thoo tih anih te a mok. Anih ham te hnokhoem rhoek boeih taengah khaw, khoboei rhoek taengah khaw, rhalboei rhoek neh, boeilu rhoek taengah khaw, Jerubabel taengah Jerusalem thoh ham aka cet rhoek te khoboe then neh doo uh a ti nah.
Coelesyria neh Phoenicia kah khoboei rhoek taengah khaw, Lebanon rhoek taengah khaw, Lebanon lamkah lamphai thing te Jerusalem la thak pah ham te a khopuei a thoh vaengah bom ham te ca a pat pah.

A ram lamloh Judaea la aka mael rhoek te khaw sayalh la caehnah thai ham, boei khaw tloe pawh, boeilu khaw tloe pawh, khoboei khaw tloe pawt, hnokhoem khaw tloe khaw tloe pawh, amih te thoka ah kanghalh pawt ham ca a pat.
Kho tom boeih ah amih kah a hut te tah mangmu khaw thoh pawt ham, Idumean loh Judah rhoek kah vangca boeih hlah pah saeh.
Bawk a saknah te a coengnah rhi hil tah amih te kum takuem talent pakul paek ham,
a thapnah ham kumkhat ah talent parha neh hnin takuem hmueihtuk dongah kah hmueihhlunah ham pae saeh, a olpaek van bangla hmueihhlut nah he hlairhih hil ah saii saeh.
Khopuei thoh hamla Babylon lamloh aka mael tah, camoe khaw, khosoih rhoek khaw sayalh la om saeh,” a ti.
Levi rhoek loh bawkim neh Jerusalem a thoh te a coengnah rhi hil a bomnah ham khaw a daek pah.
Khopuei aka tawt rhoek boeih ham, khohmuen khaw, thapang khaw, lamphu khaw hmoel pah ham a daek pah.

Cyrus loh a hoep hnopai boeih te Babylon lamloh koep mael sak. Saii hamla Cyrus loh ol paek boeih te tah, anih longkhaw saii hamla ol paek tih, Jerusalem la koep a pat.   
\s1 Zerubbable Thangthuinah
Cadong te a caeh neh a maelhmai te Jerusalem la a hooi tih, vaan kah manghai te a koeh.
Te vaengah, namah taeng lamloh tanah ha thoeng, namah lamkah tah cueihnah khaw ha thoeng, nang tah thangpomnah om pai saeh, Kai tah na sal ni.
Nang tah na yoethen pai, namah loh cueihnah nan paek, a pa rhoek kah Boeipa aw, namah ni kan uem coeng,” a ti.
Te dongah ca a loh tih Babylon la a caeh phoeiah, a huiko taengah a thui.
Te dongah amih long khaw a napa rhoek kah Pathen te a koeh uh.
Cet hang tih Jerusalem neh amih a phoeinah thil Bawkim thoh ham khaw Boeipa loh loeihnah neh kotluepnah a paek. Te dongah laa neh, omngaihnah neh hnin rhih khuiah kho a tue uh.
\s1 Vangsawn Lamkah Aka Mael rhoek
He phoeiah tah patuel imkhui kah a lu rhoek, amah koca tarhing ah, a yu rhoek khaw, a capa rhoek khaw, canu rhoek khaw, salnu salpa khaw, a rham sa khaw, caeh hamla a tueik.
Darius loh amih neh marhang caem thawngkhat a tueih pah dongah, amih khaw Jerusalem la, lumlaa neh, toembael neh, phavi neh sading la mael uh.
A huiko boeih khaw omngaihnah muep om. Te dongah amih neh a caeh ham khaw a saii pah.
He tah amah patuel imkhui ah amah koca, amah rhoihui la aka cet rhoek kah a ming ni.
Khosoih rhoek la, Aaron capa Phinehas cadil, Seraiah koca Jozadak capa Jeshua, Shaeltiel koca Zerubbabel capa Joakim, David imkhuikah khaw, Phares rhuirhong khaw, Judah koca khaw thum.
Anih long te Persian manghai hmaiah hlangcueih ol te, a manghainah a kum bae, a hlakhat nah, Nisan hla vaengah a thui.
He tah vangsawn lampah lamkah aka mael Judah rhoek ni. Amih te Babylon manghai Nebukhadnezzar loh Babylon la a khuen rhoek ni.

Amih he Jerusalem la aka mael rhoek te Judaea ah mah kho ah aka om khaw om. Amih tah amamih a lu la aka om rhoek, Zerubbale, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Sraiah, Resaih, Enenues, Mordekai, Beelsarus, Aspharasus, Reeliah, Rehum neh Baana ni.

Te vaengah amih te ka cae tih ka hmuh he, khosoih neh Levi koca a om moeh nih.
Elnathan, Shemaiah, Jarib, Nathan, Elnathan, Zekhariah neh Meshullam taengla ol ka pat. Amih tah a lu neh aka yakming hlang la om uh.
Amih te thakvoh hmuen kah hlang mawtkung la aka om, Iddo taengla caeh ham ka thui pah.
Amih te, “Iddo neh a huiko taeng neh tangka khoem rhoek taengah khaw thui pah lamtah, mamih kah Boeipa im ah khosoih bi hamla hlang han tueih saeh,” ka ti nah.
Te dongah ka Boeipa kut rham loh Israel ca, Levi koca Mahli cadil hlang tang rhoek te kamih taengla han tueih. A ming lamtah Sherebiah neh a taengkah a huiko khaw, a cadil khhaw hlang hlairhet lo uh.
Hashabiah khaw, Annunus neh a manuca Jeshaiah khaw, Hananiah cadil neh a cadidil rhoek khaw hlang pakul lo uh.

Bawkim kah tueihyoeih rhoek khaw, David loh Levi bibi mawkut la a khueh rhoek khaw, bawkim kah tueihyoeih rhoek khaw yahnih pakul lo uh. Amih te a ming rhep boeih a khueh pah.   
\s1 Yaehnah neh Thangthuinah  
\r (Ezra 8. 21-23)

Theras tuiva kaengah cadong rhoek te ka Boeipa mikhmuh ah yaehnah khueh tih, ka yincaehnah dongah sadingnah ham khaw, ka cae rhoek neh ka ca rhoek ham khaw Boeipa taengah bih hamla olcaengnah ka khueh.
Manghai taengah rhalkap khaw, marhangcaem khaw, kaimih aka puei tih rhal kut lamloh kaimih tungaep hamla bih khaw ka yak coeng.
Anih taengah tah ka Boeipa kah thaduengnah ni ka uepnah tih amah dongah aka pangtung ni a hoeptlang ti khaw ka thui coeng.

Te dongah kaimih hoeptlang hamla ka Boeipa taengah ka thangthui uh tih kamih thangthuinah te a hlat coeng.   
\s1 Bawkim Hamla Kutdoe  
\r (Ezra 8. 24-30)
Te vaengah khosoih mawtkung hlatnit te ka hoep tih, Sherebiah, Hashabiah neh a huiko hlainit lo uh.

Te vaengah amih ham te cak neh sui khaw ka loeng pah tih ka Boeipa im kah hnopai cim te khaw ka hmoel pah. Te khaw manghai mah neh a olrhoep rhoek, a boeina rhoek neh Israel pum boeih kah a paek hno ni.
Te vaengkah ka loeng tih amih ka paek te cak talent yarhuk sawmnga, cakben hnopai talent yakhat, sui talent yakhat,
Sui baeldung pakul, rhohum baelyak pakul lo. Te khaw rhohum then la om tih sui bangla phaa.
Te phoeiah amih te, “Nangmih tah a pa rhoek kah Boeipa neh Boeipa taengah na cim uh coeng. Te dongah sui neh ca khaw, a pa rhoek kah Boeipa taengah Boeipa hamla a caeng coeng.
Te rhoek te khosoih neh Levi rhoek taengla, Jeruslaem kah Israel imkhui kah pacut boeilu taengla a pha hil, mamih Boeipa im kah imkhui la a pha hil dawn hueltue uh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te dongah cak neh, sui neh Jerusalem ah aka om baelyak te a loh uh tih Boeipa kah bawkim la a khuen uh.   
\s1 Jerusalem la Maelnah  
\r (Ezra 8. 31-36)

Hlasae hnin hlainit vaengah tah Theras tuiva lamloh ka hlah uh. Ka Boeipa kah thaom kut he kaimih soah om tih Jerusalem te ka pha uh. Amah loh a hnukhmai kah rhal kut lamloh n'loeih sak dongah Jerusalem ka pha uh.
A hnin thum dongah ah tah sui neh cak ne ka loeng tih ka Boeipa im kah Uriah capa khosoih Meremoth taengah ka paek.
Anih taengah Phinehas capa Eleazar khaw, amih taengah Jeshua capa Jozabad khaw, Binnui capa Moeth khaw Levi la om uh.
A pum la tih loeng vaengah khaw, a loeng boeih te amah tue vaengah boeih hlum pah la om.
Vang sawn lamkah aka mael rhoek loh Israel Pathen Boeipa taengah hmueih boeih a nawn uh.
Te vaengah kikong sawmko parhuk, tu sawmrhih pumnit, uemnah hmueih la maae tal pum hlainit neh Boeipa taengah hmueih la a nawn uh.

Manghai kah olpaek te boei tueihyoeih taeng neh, Coelesyria neh Phonikia khoboei rhoek taengah a khuen uh. Amih tah Boeipai bawkim neh pilnam khaw a hinyanah uh.   
\b  
\s1 Ezra kah Thangthuinah
He tla a om phoeiah tah boeilu rhoek te kai taengla ha pawk uh tih,

“Israel pilnam khaw, boeilu rhoek khaw, khosoih rhoek neh Levi rhoek khaw, khohmuen pilnam neh amih kah a tihnai donglam loh amamih te khoe uh mah pawt ni? Amih te Kanani khaw, Khitti rhoek khaw, Perzi rhoek khaw, Jebusi rhoek khaw, Moab rhoek khaw, Egypt rhoek khaw, Edom rhoek pawn ni.

A ca rhoek loh he pilnam kah tanu te a loh uh. Te dongah a cim koca rhoek khaw khohmuen kah kholong pilnam neh thoek uh coeng. He olka dongah he a tongcuek lamloh mawtkung rhoek neh hlangcong rhoek khaw amih kah boethae te a cut puei coeng.
He olka he ka yaak vaengah ka himbai neh ka hnikul cim khaw ka phen coeng, ka lu neh ka baengbae sam khaw ka pham tih ngaihmang kothae la ka ngol.
Te vaengah Israel Boepa kah ol dongla aka thoeih boeih tah kai taengah tingtun uh. Kai khaw he boethae dongah ka nguek tih, hlaem hmueih tue hil kothae la ka ngol.
Te phoeiah ka yaehnah lamloh, ka himbai neh ka hnikul khaw a pawnsoem la ka thoh puei. Te phoeiah ka sungkueng thuk tih Boeipa taengla kut ka phuel.
Te vaengah, “Aw Boeipa, yah ka poh tih, na mikhmuh tah ka ngaihmang coeng.
Kaimih kah tholhnah he ka lu lakah khaw sang tih, tholhdalhnah loh vaan duela som coeng.
A pa rhoek tue lamloh tihnin duela ka tholnah he muep len.

Kamih kah tholhnah neh a pa rhoek kah tholhnah kongah ni, kaimih neh ka huiko rhoek khaw, ka manghai rhoek neh ka khosoih rhoek khaw, diklai manghai rhoek taeng ah, cunghang dongla, vangsawn la, kutbuem la, tihin ah yahhat la m'voeih coeng.
Aw Boeipa na rhennah cungnueh te kaimih teangla ha lo mai laeh mako. Kaimih ka yung phoek mai cakhaw na hmuen cim kah ming nen tah.
Ka Pathen Boeipa im ah kaimih ham vangnah tueng sak lamtah ka lamlum uh tue vaengah kaimih he buh m'pae lah.
Pinyenah khuiah pataeng ka Boeipa loh kaimih hno moenih. Te dongah nih Persian manghai taengah kolonah n'khuen tih kaimih te buh m'paek.
Te vaengah ka Boeipa kah Bawkim te a thangpom tih, Zion te khopong lamloh thoh sak ham, Judea neh Jerusalem akh ka hmuencak khueh ham pawn ni.
Aw Boeipa, he bang hno a om vaengah balae ka thui lah eh? Na olpaek te khaw ka poe uh coeng he. Te te na sal rhoek neh tonghma rhoek taengah na paek coeng ta.
Khohmuen he khohrhang la loh ham na kun thil coeng. Kholong khohmuen kah tuinu loh khohmuen a nu sak. Amih te a khawt hoeng la om coeng.
Te dongah, ‘Na tanu rhoek he amih cadil taengah vasa la tueih uh boeh. Na cadil rhoek ham khaw amih nu te loh pah boeh.
Amih neh rhoinaeng ham khaw tlap uh boeh. Te daengah ni na rhoeng uh vetih khohmuen kah hno then khaw na caak uh eh. Na carhoek ham khaw rho na caeh tak yoeyah eh,” na ti.
Te boeih te mamih taengah ha thoeng he khaw, kaimih kah boethae neh, tholhnah a yet dongah ni. Te dongah Boeipa namah loh kaimih kah tholhnah he ham phil lah.
Kaimih he a yung khaw nan phil coeng. Tedae khohmuen kah pilnam rhalawt neh ka thoek uh coeng dongah na olkhueng poe hamla ka mael uh.
Ka yung ka pa, tingan neh ka ming om pawt hil ah kaimih nan phae ham khaw kaimih taengah thintoek na hah voel pawh.
Aw Boeipa, uepom la na om dongah ni, tihnin due ka yung ka pa khaw nan paih.

Na mikhmuh ah boethae halang la ka om coeng ta he. He kah hno rhang neh na mikhmuh ka ka pai ngoeng uh pawh.   
\s1 Pitpomnah Bawt

Ezra he thangthui tih tholhphongnah a khueh vaengah, rhap tih bawkim hmai kah diklai dongah yalh. Te vaengah Jerusalem lamkah tongpa khaw, huta khaw, cadong caloe khaw a taengah muep tingtun uh. Te vaengah hlangping lakli ah bungbung rhap uh.
Israel hlang pakhat, Jehiel cap Shekaniah loh Ezra te a khue tih, “Boeipa taengah ka tholh uh coeng, kholong pilnam lamkah kholong nu te ka loh uh coeng. Tedae Israel ham ngaiuepnah om pueng.
Boeipa taengah olhlo khueh uh pawn sih. Kholong nu tah a ca neh rhenten hnoo uh pawh sih.
Nang ham neh Boeipa kah olkhueng aka ngaih boeih ham khaw aka then la koih.
Thoo lamtah thuenglaengah khueh pawn sih. Te nang hut rhoei ni. Kaimih khaw nang taengah thaomnah cungnueh la ka om uh ta,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.

Te dongah Ezra te thoo tih Israel kah mawtkung rhoek neh Levi rhoek loh a phoei ham te olphoei a khueh pah. Te dongah amih long ol a hlo uh.   
\b
Ezra te hlah uh tih bawkim vongup lamloh Eliashib capa Jehohanan kah imkhui la cet.
Yin at pahoi rhaeh tih buh khaw, tui khaw tuep pawh. Hlangping kah boethaenah a len tangkik dongah nguekcoi.
Vangsawn lamkah aka mael boeih tah Jerusalem ah tingtun hamla olhoenah te Judea neh Jerusalem tomah a khueh.

Tamna lamkah aka mael rhoek te, khoboei boeilu rhoek kah oltloek bangla hnin nit hnin thum khuiah ni a tingtun voel pawt atah, a boiva te hmueih la boeih a tuuk pah tih, hlang te hlangping khui lamloh a vai uh.
Te vaengah Judah neh Benjamin koca kah hlang rhoek tah hnin thum khuiah Jerusalem la tingtun uh. Te vaengah a hla la hla ko dongkah hnin hlainit a pha coeng.
Hlangping boeih te bawkim hmai kah toltung ah ngol uh dae khonal loh a kae uh dongah thuen uh.
Te vaengah Ezra te pai hang tih amih te, “Olkhueng a aek uh tih kholong te na loh uh dongah nih Israel kah tholhnah he a pung.
Te dongah tholh phong uh lamtah a pa rhoek kah Pathen Boeipa te thangpomnah pae uh.
A kongaih te vai uh lamtah namamih te khohmuen pilnam taeng neh na kholong nu taeng lamloh hoep uh laeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Te vaengah hlangping te boeih pang uh tih ol a len la, “Na thui bangla ka saii uh eh.
Te daenga hlangping he yet tih sikca la om. Tol tung ah pai ham tah ka noeng uh moehnih. He hno dongah ka tholhnah he muep yet tih hnin nit hnint at khaw ka bi ka saii uh thai moenih.
Te dongah hlangping te om mai saeh lamtah kai vang khui ah kholong nu aka lo rhoek mah a tuentah tue vaengah halo uh saeh.
He kah olka dongah Boeipa kah kosi lamloh n'loeih u hil amah hmuen ah mawt kung neh laitloekkung rhoek te om saeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Asahel capa Jonathan neh Tikvah capa Jahzeah loh he kah dumlai hea thui rhoi tih, Meshullam, Levi neh Shabbethai loh amih taengah laitloekkung la a bi.
Vangsawn lamkah aka mael boeih taengah hekah oltloeknah ning la a saii uh.
Ezra loh pacut imkhui kah a hlang rhoek mawtkung te amah loh a ming neh rhep a tuek. Te dongah hla rha hla sae vaengah tah olka he cae hamla hma a pai uh.

Te dongah kholong nuh aka lo tongpa rhoek te a hla khat kah hla sae dongah tah bawt a thak uh.   
\s1 Kholong Nu aka Lo Rhoek  
\r (Ezra 10:18-44)
Te vaengah khosoih rhoek la kholong nu aka lo rhoek tah,
Jozadak koca Jeshua tiingan neh a huiko rhoek, Maaseiah, Eliezar, Jarib neh Jordan om.
Te dongah amamih bit uh tih a yuu te a vawl a tueih uh. Te phoeiah a tholh hmilhnah hamla tutal neh a nawn uh.
Immer cadil la Hannani neh Zebadiah, Masseih neh Shemaiah, Jehiel nah Azariah.
Pashhur cadil la Elioienai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nathanael, Gadeliah neh Salthas.
Levi koca la Jozabad, Shimei neh Kelaiah (anih he Kelita ni), Pethaniah neh Jdah neh Jonah.
Bawkim kah laasa rhoek la Eliashab neh Zakkur.
Thoka tawt ah Shallum neh Telem.
A tloe rhoek la, Parosh koca ah Ramiah, Malkhijah, Milelos, Eleazar, Asibiah neh Beneas.
Elam koca ah Matthaniah, Zekhariah, Jezriel, Abdi, Jeremoth neh Elijah.
Zattu koca ah Elioenai, Eliashab, Othoniah, Jeremoth, Zabad neh Zerdaiah.
Bebai koca ah Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai neh Emathis.
Bani koca ah, Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jsahub, Sheal neh Jeremoth.
Addi koca ah Naathus, Moosiaas, Lakkunus, Naidus, Baskapasmys, Sesthel, Belnus neh Manesseas.
Annan koca ah, Lionas, Asiah, Melkhia, Sabbaiah, neh Simon Chosemaeus.
Hashum koca ah Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Manasseh neh Shimei.

Bani koca ah Jeremai, Maadai, Amaram, Joel, Mamdai, Bediah, Vaniah, Carabasiaon, eliashib, Machnadebai, eliasis, Binuui, Eliaslia, Shimei, Shelemiah neh Nathaniah. Ezora koca ah Shashai, Azare, Azael, Shemaiah, amariah neh Joseph.
Nebo koca ah Mattithiah, Zabad, Iddo, Joel neh Benaiah.

Hekah hlang boeih long he kholong nu a loh uh. Te dongah kholong nu te a hlak uh tih amih a ca rhoek neh rhen a tueih uh.   
\s1 Pilnam Taengah Olkhueng A Tae  
\r (Neh 7:73—8:12)
Khosoih rhoek khaw, Levi rhoek khaw, Israel pilnam hlang thawt boeih khaw Jerus salem neh vangca ah kho a sak uh. A tloe Israe ca rhoek boeih khaw a hla rhih hil amah kho ah boeih om uh.
Hla sae dongah tah rhaengpuei boeih te bawkim khothoeng voengka kah toltung ah huek suntla uh.
Khosoih boeih Ezra neh cataekung rhoek taengah khaw Israel Pathen Boeipa loh a paek Moses olkhueng te hang khuen a ti na uh.
Te dongah Ezra loh olkhueng te a khuen tih, a hlarhih dongkah hla sae vaengah tah hlangping long khaw, huta tongpa long khaw, khosoih boeih long khaw a yaak uh.
Bawkim vongka hmai kah toltung ah mincang lamloh khoyin bangli hil huta neh tongpa hmaiah khaw tha ue la a tae pah. Te vaengah olkhueng taengla hlangping hna boeih a kaeng uh.
Te vaengah khosoih neh olkhueng aka taekung rhoek te thing tlaang a khueh pa uh tih pai uh.
Amah taengah te Maatthaiah, Shema, Anaias, Azariah, Uriah, Hezekiah neh Baalsamus te a bantang ah pai.
A banvoei ah Pedaiah, Mashael, Malkhijah, Lothasuhs, Nabariah, neh Zekharih pai.
Te phoeiah olkhueng ca bu te hlangping mikhmuh ah a loh. Te te hlang boeih hmuh kah hinyanah hmueh ah a khueh.
Olkhueng te koe a phuel vaengah amih te tangawk la boeih pai uh. Te vaengah Ezra loh Khohni Pathen, Caempuei Pathen Tlungthang te a uem.
Te dongah hlangping loh khaw, “Amaen,” tila a hlat uh. A kut a phuel uh tih diklai la a bakop doeah Boeipa te a bawk uh.

Jeshua, Anniuth, Sherebiah, Jadinus, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maiannas, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, Levi rhoek loh Boeipa kah olkhueng te a thuituen tih, amah vaengah a tae te khaw a thuicaih pah.
Te vaengah Attharates khosoih boei Ezra neh cataekung rhoek taengah khaw, hlangping aka thuituen Levi rhoek neh hlang boeih taengah,
Tihin he Boeipa hamla cim,” (Olkhueng a yaak uh neh amih te boeih rhap uh coeng.)
“Na longpuei la mael uh lamtah, buh tha khaw ca uh, didip tui khaw o uh, aka khueh pawt taengah buhham khaw tael pah.
Tihnin he Boeipa kah khohnin cim ni, kothae sak aih uh boeh. Boeipa loh nangmih n'thangpom pawn ni,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Levi rhoek long khaw pilnam boeih te, “Tihin he Boeipa kah khohnin cim ni, kothae sak uh aih boeh,” \w a\w* \w ti\w* \w nah\w*.
Te daengah amah caelong la mael uh tih a caa a ok uh. Amamih khaw a kohoe uh tih aka khueh pawt ham buhham khaw a tael uh dongah omngaih nah muep a khueh.
Amih a thuituennah ol loh a thaphoh uh dongah thikat la mael uh.

headers.im: He thangthuinah he Judah manghai Manasseh kah hlohlai lung la ana pom uh. A ollung he bahoeng a then dongah hlangboel tlaivongnah tue (Reformation Age) vaengah tah Protestants rhoek long khaw laa la ana sak uh. Tedae hekah he Protestants, Roman Catholics neh Eastern Orthodox long khaw Bible dongah ana thum sak moenih.

headers.im: A noncanonical psalm that, prior to the Qumran discoveries, was known only through ancient translations (LXX, Latin, and Syriac). At Qumran the psalm was included in the Hebrew Psalm Scroll (11Q). The Hebrew text indicates two separate poems. The first poem (designated as 151A) is a commentary on 1 Samuel 16:1-13. It relates how David was set over his father’s flocks but was made king over God’s people after God had looked upon his heart. The second poem (151B) is a commentary on 1 Samuel 17 and deals with David and Goliath. It is thought by some to show the bravery of David in contrast to his humility, as is shown in 151A. LXX Septuagint

\q3 ka pilnam Israel tah  
\q1 yahpohnah khui lamloh ka hlaw

headers.cabu: he khokhuen cil la om tih kohlop koi khaw muep om. He cabu he Egypt kah aka om Jews hlang loh B.C yacut pakhat tluk vaengah a tael. A hmuethma he sawt vaengah
headers.dongkah: bangla om pawh. Te tah Makkabi rhal thoh hlan kum sawmnga tluk ah ni Judea a om coeng. Tahae kah dongah tah a kum ngai he Egypt ram ah aka thoeng te ni a tael. Te vaengah manghai Ptolemy IV Philopator (221 to 203
headers.dongah: tah kholong manghai kut lamkah Pathen hlang rhoek Pathen loh a tlannah kawng he a tael. He kah cabu he
headers.phoeikah: a kawng ni a tael. Lamhma kah Greek cayol dongah tah Makkabi cabu ana ti moenih.
headers.ip: Hmuh mueh Pathen kah thaomnah dongah thangthuinah he olpuei la a om kawng ni n'cang puei.

verses.text: \s1 Dositheus loh Philopator A Daem Sak

Manghai Philopator loh Egypt a uk vaengah,\f + \fr 1.1 \fq Philopator : \ft anih he Ptolemy IV la om (221-203 \+sc b.c.\+sc*).\f* Syria manghai Antiochus loh a muk tih a khohmuen te muep a loh pah. Egypt hlang a ngen tah yong uh tih a kawnglam te Philopator taengah a thui pa uh. Te dongah a caem te boeih a khue tih, rhalkap khaw, marhang caemg khaw a hueh. A ngannu Arsinoe te a khuen tih Egypt caem teh led the Egyptian troops Raphia pinpang la a caeh puei. Teah te Antiochus neh a rhalkap rhoek te rhaeh uh.

Takah hlaem ah tah a ming ah, Theodotus loh Philopator te ngawn tih Egypt neh Syria laklo kah caemtloek te paa sak a ngaih. Hnuk kuem lamloh a khueh Egypt kah lungpokhaica a then koek te muep a khuen tih Philopator kah dap te a huep la a paan.

Tedae teah te Judah hlang a ming ah, Dositheus om. \f + \fr 1.3 \fq Dositheus: \ft Greek “Dositheus tah Drimylus capa ni.”\f* Anih long he ana patuel rhoek kah thotuengnah te a hnawt tih Egypt rhoek taengah lat pai. Theodotus loh metla saii ham a cai te khaw Dositheus loh a ming. Te dongah Philopator te a dap lamloh a tloe la vik a caeh ham a soepsoei pah tih tekah hlaemah tah anih yueng la hlang mailai te a dap khuiah tloep a ih sak. Te dongah Theodotus loh ommongsitoe a ngawn.   
\s1 Egyptians loh Syria a na

Egypt neh Syria laklo kah caemtloeknah te a koe hlan ah anih kah caem tah yawk pawn ni tila Philopator loh a ming. Te daongah a ngannu Arsinoe tah miphi neh sampham la Epypt caem taengla cet. Amih te a yuu a ca ham thinom la caemtloek ham a hloep. Syria te a ta mak atah rhalkap pakhat ah sui coi hnih boeih paek ham ol a khueh.
Arsinoe kah mangtaengnah bangla a saii. Eypt loh Syria te a tlak sak tih amih te thongtla la muep a tuuk uh.
Tekah a tanah hnuk ah tah, Philopator loh a taengvai kah khopuei te a hip tih pilnam neh hum uh.

Bawknah hmuen kah hamla kutdoe khaw a paek. Anih kah a hip rhangneh pilnam long khaw hil uepnah a dang tih, anih mawtkung pakhat la a hinyah uh.   
\s1 Philopator Jerusalem La Cet

Judah rhoek bawknah benkah mawt kung a ngen te a tueih tih manghai Philopator te a doe uh. Te vaengah anih kah a saii hno te uem pa uh. Amih long te kutdoe rhep a khuen pa uh dae amih khopuei la a caeh te Philopator ni a lu a kil sak uh.

A hnuk bet lamtah Philopator te Jerusalem la koep pawt tih Bawkim la cet. Te vaengah aka thuem pawh hmueih te a nawn tih Khohni Pathen te a uem. Bawim kah a dung a ka neh a thennah loh Philopator te a limlum sak.
Tedongah Bawkim khui la kun ham te bahoeng a ngaih.

Philopator neh aka cet Judah hoel loh, “Manghai nah, Bawkim kah hmuencim koek ah he kaimih kah khosoih rhoek he cet a mailai moenih. Khosoih Boei pataeng kum khat ah vai bueng ni a khui la a caeh sak,” a ti nah.  
 Amih te tangnah hamla Philopator loh a aal.

Te vaengah hlangvang loh Moses kah olkhueng cabu te a ong pah. Bawkim kah hmuencim koek ah khosoih boei bueng caeh ham Pathen loh a paek rhoek te a kaang la a tae pah.\f + \fr 1.12 \ft Lev 16.1-2\f*  
 Manghai loh, “Hlang tloe rhoek a kun sak pawt oe a khaw, balae ti kai caeh thai pawt mai eh?
Bawk im khui ah kut pawt ham khaw uloh kai he han hloh noek moenih,” a ti.
Poeknah aka om pawh hlang loh a anglat neh, “Na poek tholh coeng te, a tloe ah boeih na caeh bangla bawkim khuiah khaw na cet thai tah,” a ti nah.

Philopator loh, “He ram hamla a soeprhaep boeih ka sai coeng a khui ah kun neh kun pawt ham khaw na ti uh tang a,” a ti nah.   
\s1 Pilnam loh Philopator A Sim
Khosoih rhoek tah khosoih himbai neh bakop uh tih Khohin Pathen taengah amih bom ham te Philopator kah a saii ham koi te paa sak ham a bih uh. Te vaengah amih te ngoingoi rhap uh.
Jerusalem kah boeih khaw let uh tih aka om noek pawt te om tila a ming uh dongah bawkim la boeih cet uh.

Hlang timpalak ah aka phoe noek pawt huta camoe long khaw a lu dongah laivai a phul uh tih kothaenah a tueng sak uh. Te phoeiah amanu neh rhen yong uh. Amih kah rhung rhah ol te Jerusalem ah khuk bae.
Vasa ham aka cai hu ta rhoek khaw a imkhan te a caehtak tih longpuei ah taai uh. Amih te a ngen nakyal la om uh.
Manu neh huta cacun rhoek long khaw camoe khoem ham a hnilh uh tih bawkim la yong paitok uh. Camoe te im neh longpuei ah sut a hlah uh.
Hlang boeih te bawkim la yong uh tih bawkim khuila Philopator a kun pawt ham Pathen taengah a bih uh.
Te vaengah pilnam thinom rhoi-at loh Philopator te paa sak ham amah ah caai uh.

Khopuei kah rhalkap rhoek te khaw pumcum muk tih hlamat khaw Moses Olkhueng ham te rhalthen la duek ham khaw a thui pa uh. Pilnam rhoek tah bawkim khuiah khoponah la muep om uh coeng. A tloihsoi ah tah patong rhoek neh mawt kung rhoek loh amih te khat neh khat ham thangthui uh ti la a hloep.
Thintang kotang la thangthui uh.
Te vaengah bawknah ben mawt kung rhoek long tah Philopator kah a mangtaengnah mangkhak te paa sak ham a voek uh.
Te dae amih te phu uh pawh. Anih te mangkhak la om tih a thui uh boeih te khaw a hnawt dongah Bawkim khui la kun ham a tong.

A saii van neh a tangkah pilnam long khaw, a tangkah sal rhoek khaw thangthui uh. Te vaengah amih te puenthae lamloh hoeptlang ham neh rhaithae manghai Philopator te dantat ham Pathen taengah a bih uh.
A kaang la a thangthui uh dongah bang khaw n'ya thai pawh.

Te vaengah Jerusalem pangbueng neh lunglai amah khaw amih neh aka thangthui koemboei la koih. Philopator te bawkim khuila kun tih a koihvaih mueh la Pathen a bawk lakah atah amamih a duek ham ni ko a tam uh.
\s1 Khosoih Boei Simon kah Thangthuinah

Khosoih Boei Simon te bawkim benla mang tih a kho sungkueng thuk. Te phoeiah vaan la a ban a phuel rhep thangthui:   
i1

Kaimih kah Pathen thaom koek aw, nang bueng ni vaan kah a cim manghai neh suentae boeih ukkung la na om. Hlang muen neh mangkhak kawng dongah kho ka pam tuh tih ka patang uh coeng. Te dongah ka thangthunah he hnatun lah.   
i1

Hno cungkuem na saii tih te rhoek soah a tiktam la na uk. Tedae amah kah thadueng dongah aka hangdang hlang tah dan na tat.   
i1
Hnukbuet vaengah khaw, boethae aka saii boeih te na phae tih hlanglen hlang rhalh khaw tuiphu neh na khoe.

Sodom khopuei kah pilnam aka hoemdam rhoek te ngawn ham kat hmai na tueih pah. Amih kah boethae longpuei aka vai hlang thae duet rhoek ham sawt koila na khueh pah.   
i1
Na pilnam cim Israel sal la aka khueh Egypt manghai na toel vaengkah na thaomnah mah khuet tangkik coeng. Thinthah manghai boeih tah rhih om khosing nen ni na toel.
Na pilnam te caem neh leng neh a hlaak dae amih te Carhaek Tuili dung ah ni na buek sak. Tedae namah aka uepnah na na hlawt. Diklai pum he namah kah tumbaemnah khuiah ni a om pai.

Namah kah kopoekrhai tanah ne a hmuh daengah Israel ca loh thaomnah aka khuet Pathen nang te n'koeh uh.   
i1

Ka manghai aw, diklai pum he na saii tih te nueh ham khaw len aih. A cungkuem he na khueh ngawn dae Jerusalem he namah long ni na tuek. Te dongah ah ni nang kan bawknah uh bawkim he yoethen na paek. Heah he na thangpomnah kho aa neh na loh tih he bawkim khaw a yoeyah la namah bawknah neh koehnah hmuen la dawk na khueh.
Israel na lungnah he ba hoeng tlo. Te dongah ahnih tholhnah neh ka ngaihmang vaengkah ham ol na khueh. Thangthui ham ka lo vaengah he na hnatun bitni.

Na olkhueh khoembael hamkhaw uepomnah na khueh yoeyah.   
i1
Hnuk buet kah a tue te yet khuiah a pa rhoek te aka muen rhal loh patang vaengah khaw na hlawt coeng.
Te dongah kaimih kah a cim manghai aw, kaimih kah patangnah he solah. Na taengah ka tholh uh coeng. Ka rhal loh n'tumbaem coeng tih ka tat uh tloel.
He hlang thae loh kaimih kah kothae ngaithae a omtoem. Namah bueng hinyahnah hamla ka sak uh bawkim khuila kun coeng.
Na im tah vaan a sangkoek ah om tih tela aka cet thai khat khaw a om pawt te ka ming uh.

Lungma na ti dongah Israel pilnam he namah ham na coelh. Te dongah na thangpomnah om saeh tila hmuen cim he khaw a khueh.   
i1
Manghai Philopator neh a hlang rhoek loh boethae halang a saii dongah kaimih he dantatnah han khueh boel mai.

Amih kah thadueng loh bawkim a phae coeng. Te koinih luki rhoek kah bawknah hmuen la om vetih a hohi la poeh pawh ni.   
i1
Na taengah ka tholh uh he khodawk ngai lamtah kaimih soah sitlohnah tueng sak laeh.

Te daengah ni ngaihmang neh ngaidaeng rhoek loh namanh koeh ham laa a sak thai he. Ngaimongnah om sak ham kaimih m'bom lah.   
\s1 Philopator Sokah Dantatnah

21-22 A cim Pathen, hno cungkuem aka suen tih a soah aka dawn loh Simon loh a yaak. Te dongah khohli loh caphoei yoeikoek la a yawn bangla Philopator te talh a boh. Philopator tah pahoi yuui tih cal thai voel pawh. A mangkhak neh a hoemdam te ni Pathen loh dan a tat coeng.
Philopator kah boei rhoek neh taengom rhoek tah thuen uh. A mae hma uh tih aka duek la a ngai uh. Te dongah anih te hlangping lakli lamloh a mawt uh.

Philopator te koep sae dae Judah rhoek taengah a yut moenih. Anih te vawpvawp a toel dae ta. Jerusalem lamloh a nong vaengah tah amih soah kosi a sah.   
\s1 Philopator loh Judah a phaep
Manghai Philopator went Alexandria kah im la bal. Teah te Judah rhoek boeih te a phaep. Amah neh aka o a pueipo rhoek loh a thaphoh. Amih long te a thuem saii ham a ming uh moenih.

Philopator loh tae lek tae na pawt hil anah la sarhingkoi te a saii dae dam a ti pah moenih. Khopuei vangca kah khosa Judah rhoek taengah rhih om puen yilh a caak sak. Judah rhoek patang sak ham te Philopator te a paya rhoek loh muep a bom uh.

Te dongah amih te rhep a hnah uh.  
 Judah rhoek kah bawknah hmuen vongup ah imsang dongah kam a ling ca a tarhit.   
i1

Jews rhoek loh Greek pathen Dionysus taengah hmueih nawn kuekluek saeh. Te daengah nih he bawknah hmuen ah ka kun sak eh. Judah rhoek kah amih te cabu dongah boeih tael saeh lamtah mangmu thoo saeh. Te phoeiah amih te sal la om uh saeh. Hekah saii hem aka aal tah hnaemtaek saeh lamtah duek sak saeh.   
i1
Dionysus pathen kah muei la aka om dingpae hnah te Judah rhoek a vin dongah a mang daek pa uh. Amih kah hamsum a yol aka om te boeih pit la om saeh.

Pilnam loh a thae la a paek te Philopator loh ngaih pawh. Te dongah a dang kah ol te a rhaep tih kutnoek a khueh thil.  
i1 Judah hlang khat khat long nih a ngaih tih Dionysus pathen te a bawk atah Alexandria kah khosaknah hamsum te rhep paek la om ni.   
\s1 Judah rhoek kah hlatnah
Alexandria kah Judah hlangvang long tah amah bawknah dongah uepomnah phu te paek ngaih uh pawh. Te dongah Philopator taengah kung hamla a bih uh. Teni amih ham a then ngai hno la a ngaiuep uh.
Tedae Judah hlang a yet ngai long tah amah bawknah te hnoo uh pawh. Ngawnnah te rhael a ngaih uh dongah cabu aka hutnah boei te kutdoe a paek uh.

Uepomnah neh aka cak Judah rhoek van long tah amih te khatkhat loh n'khang ni tila a tangnah uh. Philopator taengla aka kun boekoek Judah rhoek te a thina uh. Rhal bangla a poek uh amih neh khaw benbo uh pawh.

Judah rhoek loh dantatnah rhael ham a saii ti boethae manghai Philopator loh a ming van neh, Alexandria kah Judah rhoek so a thintoeknah bahoeng sai. Khotaeng khovai kah taengah khaw sai coeng. Te dongah amih te boeih duek sak hamla ol tlek a paek.
He tlam a caai vaengah pilnam a ngen long tah Judah rhoek a hmuhhuet tih amih kah puencak te hmuh a ngaih uh. Judah rhoek mangkhak mai la manghai olkhueng vai pawt a saii a ti uh.
Tedae Judah rhoek manghai taengah uepom la om hlang he ngaihmangnah a paek moenih.
A Pathen te a bawk uh tih a olkhueng te a vai uh. Amamih kah caakok dongah khaw ngaithuennah neh om uh. Pilnam a ngen long tah Judah rhoek a hong ni, boethae aka saii ni a ti uh.
Pilnam a kum ngai long tah Judah rhoek te hinyah uh tih amih te ommongsitoe hlang ni a ti uh.
Te lalah khaw Judah rhoek loh Egypt ah hno then aka saii te kholong rhoek long tah a hnalval uh tih, Judah rhoek kah puencak bueng te a poek uh.
Kholong rhoek loh Judah rhoek te a uet uh tih Judah rhoek kah bawknah neh caak ok kawng te nueihbu la a saii uh. Judah rhoek loh manghai a tloelh tih mawtkung ol ngai pawh tila ol a haeh uh.

Judah hlang rhoek a hnaemtaek uh te hnin at ah tah, Alexandria kah Gentile rhoek loh a hmuh tih a thintoek uh. He Gentile rhoek khaw ukkung aka muen loh a uk van dongah let uh. Amih long khaw tithainah khueh uh van pawh. Judah rhoek te a hloep uh tih hnothen ha thoeng bitni a ti na uh.
Judah rhoek soah a thae saii ham a tueng moenih tila amih loh a ming uh.

Te dongah kuirhang rhoek neh Judah rhoek kah a paya a ngen longtah Judah rhoek te a coeng thai khuiah bom hamla cai uh.   
\s1 Philopator kah Hnaemtaeknah Olpaek

Manghai Philopator tah a bisai a coeng dongah koevoei uh. Anih aka paa sak ham thadueng aka u khaw om pawh, Khohni Pathen long pataeng paaa sak mah pawh tila a poek.  
 Philopator loh a dangkah bangla ca a tael:   
i1

Manghai Ptolemy Philopator loh \f + \fr 3.12 \fq King Ptolemy Philopator: \ft 1.1. sawt thil\f* ka rhalboei rhoek neh ka khorhi khui kah rhalkap rhoek boeih kut kan tuk uh. Na sa boeih ding uh tila ka ngaiuep.   
i1
Mamih ram he tah a thaomnah neh cakrhuet la om.
Te dongah Asia la vathoh khaw bahoeng thaihtak. Mamih kah pathen he mamih taengah om taktak.
Te dongah Syria puei khorhi kah khosa pilnam boeih taengah rhennah khueh tih amih te rhal bangla pawt tih paya bangla voemtoei ham ni ol n'tloek uh.
Amih kah bawknah hmuen hinyahnah ham tangka hamsum khaw m'paek. Jerusalem kah bawknah hmuen ham khaw amah te tlam ni m'mangtaeng uh. Teah te Judah hlang ang rhoek loh a bawk uh.
Teah te bahoeng ka uem a ti uh. Tedae bawkim cim khui la kun tih a phu aka tlo kutdoe neh thangpom ham ka bih dae kun sak ham a aal uh.
Amih he bahoeng mankhak uh tih amah noek lam ni a om uh. Amih he dantat dingrhae ham thuem coeng dae amih soah rhennah n'khueh tih a tloh n'yaak sak uh moenih.

Judah rhoek koekkoek pawn ni kholong kah ukkung rhoek a then neh a thuem aka tangnah pawt rhoek he. Tedongah mamih khaw n'sawtsit uh tih n'thiinah uh.   
i1
Mamih kah tanah hnukah Egypt la ka mael vaengah khaw Judah rhoek te a then lamni nsawt uh. Tedae amamih kah hlang ang khoboe khaw hlapham ham ni ko ka tam uh.

Judah rhoek rhennah ham te hlang tom taengah ka thui uh. Amih neh paipi ok bueng kolla uknah dongah khaw amih te thum uh van. Alexandria kah khosa tak la ka om sak uh bueng kolla kaimih bawknah khotue ah khaw ka khue uh.
Tedae a mangkhak uh mai la kaimih loh moeihoeih la ka doedan khaw a thana uh. Ama rhoe pawn ni a thae bueng ni a huet uh. Te ongah Alexandria hlang coeng ham khaw ngaih uh pawh.

Mah hlang la coengnah aka dang rhoek rhap a khaih uh. Te dongah amih sokah khokhan khueh he khaw tho a ngaih coeng. He boeih sawt vaengah amih he a lungmong uh aih.   
i1
Judah rhoek loh a hnukhmai la mamih n'nen muep he paan ah ni ka thui coeng. Hnin at ah ngawn tah mamih n'tloelh pawn ni, mangtaengnah khueh uh pawn sih.

He kah capat na tae uh nen tah Judah boeih te tongpa khaw, huta neh camoe khaw na khorhi khuikah khosa rhoek te han thak uh. Amih te lungma ti uh boeh. Thirhui neh boeih khit uh vik yong uh ve. Amih te a phu aka om mueh rhalcak neh laihmu bangla duek sak uh ham om.

Judah rhoek te a duek bangtlang boeih daengah ni mamih kah ram khaw a mong pueng eh.   
i1
Patong khaw, camoe khaw Judah hlang aka thuh van te tah a imkhui boeih a dueknah hil phaep la om ni.

Tedae ukhaw Judah rhoek a omnah te kaimih taengla aka puen hlang tah tangka thawnghnih paek vetih anih te thinom hlang tila thangpom la om ni. Tedae Judah hlang aka thuh te tah laihmuh la om vetih a koerhang khaw tuuk pa la om ni.
Te vaengah a thuhnah hmuen te khaw a yoeyah khaih la om ni.
He kah capat he a toeng patoeng saii lamtah Philopator kah ram khuiah ah boeih pat uh.
\s1 Jews rhoek Alexandria la a khuen

Philopator kah capat loh kho takuem a pha, te vaengah mawtkung rhoek loh Greek hlang thantpomnah poei a saii uh. Amih long loh Judah rhoek a thinkha la a thiinah te a phah thai voel pawt dongah a uum uh.
Tedae khopuei rhoek kah Judah rhoek tah mat lakueng uh tih khomap uh. Manghai loh amih ngawn ham kawng dongah Jduah rhoek kah a rhung neh a rhah tah paa thai voel pawh.
Ram khopuei vangca kah longpuei takuem ah kothae la nguekcoi uh.

Te vaengah amih te Alexandria la thak ham caempuei rhalboei rhoek tah rhuengphong uh. .  
 Judah rhoek sokah dantatnah he tlo tangkik aih. Te dongah a rhal rhoek khuikah a ngen tah mat rhap uh. Tebang sarhing koi dueknah he a hmuh noek pawt dongah a ko bahoeng thae uh.
Patong tongpa rhoek khaw a mangkhak maila khopuei longpuei ah khotling la a vaan sak uh.

Huta tanoe vasakung rhoek long khaw omngaihnah laa te a toeng uh tih khothae neh nguek uh. A sam botui mai te maiphu a phul thil uh. Vasak vaegkah himbai te boeih a pit uh uh amih Alexandria aka khuen te a rhing uh. Greek boei rhoek loh amih a thaekhanah dongah mat rhap uh.
Yulokung rhoek te khaw hlangping hmuh ah thirhui neh a sol uh tih Alexandria la khuen ham sangpho tuikaengah a rhing sak uh.

Ompaek kah a va khaw duek koeloe pawn ni tila a ngai uh. A rhawn dongah rhaipai yueng la rhui khak a oi sak. Omngaih omthenbawn khaw paa tih kopang tlohnah la poeh. Judah yulo kung rhoek te long puei ah a khuen uh. A rhawn dongah rhaihulh yueng la thirhui a oi uh. Amih loh dueknah m'paan coeng ti a ming uh dongah omngaih bawnnah khaw kopangnah la poeh.
Judah rhoek te thirhui neh a khih uh tih kohong rhamsa bangla lawng taengla a mawt uh. A ngen tah a rhawn ah hlong khak a khh pa uh. A ngen tah a khocin ah thirhui neh a khih uh.

Amih te rhalcak bangla a phaek uh tih sangpho cirhong hmui la a det uh. Te dongah Alexandria la a caenah he kho la yin.   
\s1 Judah rhoek thongtla la poeh

Alexandria la Judah rhoek aka phuei sangpho te Schedia ah duem. Judah rhoek te khopuei vongka hmaikah toltung puei ah rhenten khueh hamla Philopator loh ol a paek. Alexandria la aka kun boeih loh Judah rhoek te hmuh saeh lamtah luemnah saeh ti a ngaih. Judah rhoek te manghai taengom neh rhep voek uh thae pawt ham neh amih kho khopuei khuiah om pawt ham a saii.
Alexandria kah Judah hlang a ngen tah khopuei lamloh duem cet uh. Judah thongtla rhoek sarhingrhup la dantatnah toltung la pawnpawn cet uh. Tete Philopator loh a yaak vaengah barhoeng sai.
Te dongah Alexandria kah Judah rhoek boeih te dantat van ham a rhalkap rhoek te ol a paek.
Judah rhoek boeih kah a ming te ukkung kah cabu dongah a tael sak. Tedae amih te sal bi sak ham moenih. Amih te dueknah paek ham nih manghai loh a mangtaeng.
Manghai kah bibikung rhoek loh khohnin sawmli khuiah Judah rhoek ming te a hlum uh dae coeng uh pawh.

Philopator tah a cainah vanbangla hnukkhueng ah Judah rhoek te a ngawn. A rhaepnit la a saii tih a cal vaengah hlang a tat pawt ham a khueh. Anih kah mueirhol thangpom ham neh bawk hamla khotue a saii. Te mueirhol rhoek te cal thai pawt tih hlang khaw a bom thai moenih. Khohni Pathen hliphen ham te Philopator tah tlungmu.

A tue bet a di phoeiah tah Judah rhoek te “Rhaithak Khopuei,” la ming aka om Ptolemais a pha uh.\f + \fr 7.17 \fq Ptolemais: \ft Tahae tue kah Kairo khopuei tlangpuei kilomter 20 a hlanah Nile tuiva kaengah om mai coi ni.\f* Amih im la aka phuei sangpho tah teah te duem. Amih hlawtnah te koep uum hamla Judah rhoek loh kovainah a khueh uh dongah sangpho loh hnin rhih a rhing.
Amih loh Philopator te a oep uh. Amih im la a mael vaengkah ham a ngoe boeih te anih long ni a khaan pa tih a paek.
Sangpho dong lamloh sading la a rhum uh vaengah tah Judah rhoek loh bahoeng a uem uh. Te dongah tekah khohnin te tah yincaehnah khotue la rhawp poek ham oltloeknah a khueh uh.

A im la a mael uh hlan vaengah kaam lung te a hmuh uh tih kum takuem kah te khohnin ah khotue cim te saii hamla olpaek te a tarhit uh. Te hmuen te khaw thangthuinah hmuen cim la a nawn uh.  
 Amih kah im caeh long boeih tah lan ah khaw, tui dongah khaw sading la caeh ham te Philopator loh a saii pah coeng dongah sading la im a pha uh van. Amih te loeih uh coeng tih thongtla a poeih uh voel pawt dongah bahoeng omngaih uh.
Te dongah a rhal rhoek long khaw Judah rhoek te a hinyahnah coeng tih amih paya la khueh ham ol a kam uh.

Judah rhoek kah koerhang aka lo rhoek long khaw Pathen loh ns'saai pawn ko a ti uh dongah lakueng uh. Te dongah ukkung cabu dongah a om bangla Judah rhoek kah koerhang te koep mael ham khaw pilnam loh a thahlue uh.  
\s1 Pathen Koeh Pai Saeh  
 Khohi Pathen loh khobaerhambae a saii te he cabu dongah tael la om coeng. Te dongah Judah rhoek khaw dueknah lamloh hlawt pai rhoe saeh.
Israel pilnam aka khang Pathen a yoeyah yuhui neh thangthen pai saeh. Amen.

headers.im: Esdras II kah a lungui (chs 3-14) he Palestinian Jew hoel loh a tael. A thapnah rhoi la (a boel 1-2 neh 15-16) rhoek he tah a hnuk lam ni a tael uh. Tuengrhuem cabu he Hebrew ol la tael paka coi ni. Greek, Coptik a ngancin ngancawn la muep om. Tedae Syriac, Ethiopic, Arabic, Armenian, Georgian, neh Latin tueng rhuem om la muep ana kong uh coeng. He kah cabu dongah he tangnca rhoek kah hnaemtaeknah kawng muep a tueng sak. Te dongah cabu he AD 95-100 tluk vaengkah a tael mai coini. Tedae Aboel 15 neh 16 tah AD 120 neh 300 tluk kah catael dan neh vai uh.

verses.text: \s1 Ezra kah Rhuirhong
He tonghma cabu he tah Azariah koca, Seraiah capa Ezra kah ni. Azariah he Ahitub cadil, Zadok capa Shallum koca Hilkiah capa ni.
Hilkiah he tah Eleazar capa Phinehas koca Abishua cadil, Borith ka a ca Unzzi capa Arna koca, Maraimoth ka a ca Amariah capa Eli capa Phinehas koca Ahijah capa ni.

Eleazar he khaw Levi koca Aaron cadil ni. Anih he Persian mangah Artaxrerxes tue vaengkah Medes ram la a sol uh.   
\s1 Ezra Khuenah
Boeipa ol tah kataengla ha thoeng tih,
“Cet lamtah ka pilnam kah boethae a saii he phong laeh, a ca rhoek loh kai taengah boethae a saii uh coeng. Te daengah ni a ca rhoek kah a ca rhoek taengah khaw a thui uh eh.
A napa rhoek kah a tholhnah te a ca rhoek taengah a koei uh, amih loh kai n'hnilh uh tih kholong kah pathen taengah hmueih a nawn uh.
Egypt khohmuen kah thong im lamloh amih aka doek te kai moenih a? Tedae amih loh kai m'veet uh tih ka cilsuep te a hnawt uh.
Te dongah na lu dongkah na sam te poelh lamtah boethae boeih te amih soah thithut laeh. Amih loh ka olkhueng ngai uh pawt tih boekoek pilnam lamni a om uh.
Amih te me hil nim ka ueh vetih, amih soah hoeikhangnah khaw meyet hil nim ka khueh lah ve?
Amih yoe ham ni manghai khaw muep ka palet. Pharaoh neh a sal rhoek khaw, a caem khaw ka tloek pah dae.

Amih hmaiah namtom khaw boeih ka phae tih, khothoeng ah khocut panit kah pilam khaw ka taekyak ta. Nangmih hamla Bethsaida khopuei ka phae tih tuithim khopuei panit ka hlup moenih a? Tyre neh Sidon kah amih rhal te khaw ka ngawn pah ta.   
\s1 Israel taengakh
Tedae amih te voek lamtah thui pah, Boeih loh a thui coeng.
Tuipuei longah nangmih aka mawt khaw kamah rhep ni. Caenglong a om nah pawt ah dingsuek longpuei aka tuk pah khaw kamah ni. Nangmih kah mawtkung la Moses, khosoih la Aaron kam paek coeng.
Nangmih ham hmai tung dong lamkah hmaivang kang khueh tih nangmih lakli ah kopoekrhai a lenkoek khaw kang khueh coeng. Te lalalah ni kai nan hilh uh Boeipa loh a ti.
Tlungthang Boeipa loh he ni a thui. Nangmih kah miknoeknah la tanghuem om tih, na tungaepnah ham rhaehhmuen kam paek dae a khuiah na kohuet uh bal pueng.

Na thunkha rhoek a pocinah khuiah ka ming khaw na pomsang uh pawt hmanah tahae kohnin hil na kohuet uh bal pueng.\f + \fr 1.16 \ft Nangmih aka hloem neh a caem rhoek te khaw tuili ah ka buek sak dae pilnam loh amah kah pocinah dongah kohuet uh \f*
Nangmih kan tuem te banglae a hoeikhangnah. Khosoek ah na pongnaeng uh tih na halthi uh vaengah ahtah kai taengah na pang uh pawt nim?
Kamih ngawn ham balae tih khosoek la nang khuen? Khosoeik ah duek ham lakah tah Egypt ham thohtat pah he mamih hamla then ngai coeng,” na ti uh.
Na hueinah uh te lungma ka ti dongah na caak uh ham manna kam paek tih puencawn buh na caak uh.
Na halh uh vaengah lungto ka phaek tih tui muep a phuet moenih a? Kholing vaengah khaw thing hnah neh nangmih kang khuk dae ta.
Khohmuen laimen te nanming kam phaeng tih Kanaan khaw, Perzzi khaw, Philitian khaw nangmih hmaiah ka haek. Naming ham balae a pueh la kan saii bal bueng eh? Boeipa loh he ni a thui.
Tlungthang Boeipa loh he ni a thui, khosoek kah na om uh vaengah tuikhaa sok ah tuihalh neh ka ming na soehsal uh.

Tedae nangmih kah soehsalnah soah nangmih te hmai kan tueih pawt tih, tui dongah thing na khoh uh vaengah sokca tui khaw koep tui.   
\s1 Israel kah Althanah neh Hnoonah
“Aw Jakob nang taengah balae kan saii eh? Judah nang khaw kai ol na ngai moenih. Namtom taengla ka mael vetih ka ming he amih ni ka paek pawn eh. Te daengah ni ka olrhi he a tuem uh eh.
Kai nan hno uh dongah nanming kan hno van ni. Kai taengah rhennah nan bih akhaw nangmih te rhennah kan tueng mahpawh.
Kai nan khue uh vaengah khawng nangmih taengla ka hnatung mahpawh. Na kut te thii neh na poeih uh tih na kho khaw hlang ngawnnah kungla hoi uh paitok.
Kai nan hnawt la poek uh boeh, namamih ni na hnawt uh coeng tila Boeipa loh a thui.
Tlungthang Boeipa loh he ni a thui. A napa loh a ca rhoek, a namu, a canu rhoek, camoe ca-om rhoek a toei bangla nangmih kan toei.
Namah man sue ka ca la na om uh vetih na pa la ka om pai sue.
Ainu loh a ca rhoek a phae hmuiah ah a ku bangla nangmih kang ku. Tedae nangmih ham bangnim ka saii lah ve? Nangmih he ka mikhmuh lamloh kang haek pawn ni.
Kai taengah na olcaeng nan thung uh vaengah khaw nangmih taeng lamloh ka maelhmai ka hoi pawn ni. Nangmih kah khotue hnin khaw, hla sae khaw, pumsa kah rhetnah khaw ka hnawt coeng.
Ka tueiyoeih tonghma rhoek te nangmih taengla kan tueih coeng dae, amih te na khuen uh tih na ngawn uh, a pum te maeh la na poel uh. Nangmih kah thii te kan suk ni. Boeipa loh he ni a thui.
Te dongah Boeipa loh he ni a thui. Na im te khopong la om vetih, khohli long cangkong a yawn bangla nangmih te kan haek ni.
Na ca rhoek long ca khueh mahpawh. Nangmih taengah om uh tih ka olpaek te a poe dongah ka mikhmuh ah a thae te a saii uh.
Na im te pilnam aka lo taengah ni ka paek eh. Amih loh kai kawng ya noek pawt dae kai n'tangnah uh. Ka olpaek a saii uh ham miknoek pakhat khaw amih ka tueng pawt dae ta.
Tonghma khaw hmu noek pawtdae a hnuksul pai hmuen te koep a thoelh uh ta.
Aka thoeng ham pilnam kah khoboe ham laipai ka khue ni. Ka pum he hmu uh pawt cakhaw ka thui ol he a mueihla neh a tangnah dongah a ca rhoek khaw omngaih kohoe neh om ni.
A pa khothoeng lamkah aka pawk pilnam kah hoemdamnah ke so lamtah hmu van lah.
Amih taengah mawt kung la, Abraham, Isaak, Jacob, Hosea, Amos, Micah, Joel, Obadiah, Jonah,
Nahum, Habakkuk, Zephaniah, Haggai, Zechariah, Malachi ka paek ni. Amih te Boeipa kah puencawn la a khue uh coeng.
Boeipa loh he ni a thui, pilnam he piyennah khui lamkah ka doek tih, amih ka sal tonghma rhoek lamloh olpaek te ka paek. Te dae hnatun uh pawt tih ka cilsuep te a hnawt uh.
Amih aka cun manu rhoek te thui pa uh, namah longpuei ah cet uh, ka ca rhoek, kai he nuhmai neh a voeih lamni ka om coeng.
Nang te kohoenah neh, kothae neh, hnorhih la kan khuen dae nang kan hlong coeng. Boeipa mikhmuh ah na tholh uh tih, ka mikhmuh ah boethae na saii uh dongah ni.
Tedae nangmih taengah bang nim kan saii lah ve. Kai he nuhmai neh a voeih lam ni ka om coeng, ka ca rhoek aw na longpuei ah cet lamtah Boeipa kah rhennah te toem laeh.
Ca rhoek kah a manu taengah laipai thapnah hamla a pa nang te kang khue coeng. Amih loh ka paipi te tuem uh hae mahpawh.
Te daengah ni amih taengah ngaihmangnah na khuen vetih a manu te pocinah khui la na khuen vaengah amih khaw ca om kolla a om eh.
Ka paipai a hnoelrhoeng uh van dongah amih te namtom rhoek taengla taekyak uh saeh lamtah a ming te diklai lamloh bit van saeh.
“Anunae Assyria nang aih te, na khuiah boethae na uep! Halang namtom aw, Sodom neh Gomorrah taengah ka saii te poek.
A khohmuen te aek tung te hmaiphu kawnhnawt lam ni a yalh lah ko. Ka ol aka hnatun pawt rhoek taengah te tlam ni ka saii eh. He tah tlungthang Boeipa long ni a thui.
Boeipa loh Ezra taengah, “Ka pilnam te thui pah, amih te Jerusalem kah poengnah te ka paek ni. Te ni Israel taengah khaw paek hamla ka caii.
Te phoeiah kamah loh amih kah thangpomnah te koep ka lat vetih, hlang tloe taengah kumhal khohmuen la ka paek ni. Te te Israel paek hamla ka hmoel coeng dae ta.
Hingnah thingkung loh amih te hmuehmuei botui a paek ni. Te vaengah amih te thakthae pawt vetih tawnba voel mahpawh.
Cet lamtah nang te n'doe bitni, thang thui lamtah na khohnin khaw yol vetih, bawn mai bitni. Ram he nang ham la a hmoel oepsoeh coeng, ana so nawn.

Khue laeh, vaan neh diklai te laipai taengla khue laeh. Boethae te ka rhoe tih boethen ni ka saii he kai tah aka hing la ka om dongah ni ti he Boeipa loh a thui.   
\s1 Boethen Thaphohnah
“Manu aw, na ca rhoek te kop laeh, amih te kohoenah neh poeh laeh. Vahu loh a saii bangla amih kho te cang sak laeh. kai long nang ka choelh coeng,” tila Boeipa loh a thui.
Aka duek khaw amah hmuen lamloh ka thoh vetih amih ming te ka ming coeng dongah amih te hlan khui lamloh a doek ni.
Camoe rhoek kah a manu aw rhihboeh, Boeipa loh nang kan tuek coeng a ti.
Nang bom hamla ka sal Isaiah neh Jeremiah te kan tueih ni. Amih rhoi kah cilsuep bangla ka ciim coeng tih nang ham thingkung hlainit te a thaih soepraep neh ka hmoel coeng.
Amah te yet buelh la sokca phuet tih suktui neh khoitui long lah ko. Te vaengah tlang a len parhih om tih a soah rhaithak neh tuilipai khaw poe. Te tlam ni na ca rhoek te omngaihnah te ka bae sak eh.
Nuhmai kah hamsum te ngaithuen lamtah, oldongah tiktamnah khaw tuem, vawtthoek te khaw pae lamtah, cadah te rhun, pumtling te khuk.
Hmalaem neh thahnoeng khaw ngaithuen lamtah aka khaem khaw lawn boeh. Aka ngoi te tungaep lamtah mikdael long khaw ka rhuepomnah he hmu van saeh.
Patong neh na vongtung khuikah camoe te khaw thingthung.
Hlang duek na hmuh vaengah amih te phuel la thak lamtah miknoek khaw khueh pah. Ka thohkoepnah khuiah nang te a hmuen tanglue kan paek van bitni.
Paa lamtah kuemsuem laeh, ka pilnam aw na mongnah tah ha pai pawn ni.
Ca-om then aw, na ca rhoek te khut lamtah a kho te cang sak.
Nangmih taengla kam paek sal rhoek te pakhat khaw poci boel saeh. Nangmih kah a tarhing la amih te kan suk ni.
Mawn boeh, soekloeknah neh notahnah hnin ha pai pawn ni. A tloe rhoek te rhah neh kothae la om vaengah, nangmih te kohoe neh a puehkan la na khueh uh ni.
Nangmih te hamtom loh n'uet ni. Tedae nangmih taengah pakhat ca pataeng saii ham khaw coeng uh mahpawh ti he Boeipa loh a thui.
Ka thaomnah loh nangmih hoeptlang vetih na ca rhoek loh hell khaw hmu mahpawh.
